On occasion, you'll come across the store cat.   I'll be back? - Oh, yes.   When: November 10, 2018 Why: Elf Accessories

I know 5 stars for a donut place is outrageous, but when I need a donut fix this is where I go. What's even more weird, I just like your basic donuts. My favorites are Chocolate Long John and the Traditional Glazed (circle donut with the hole in the center). I really like the the donut holes, the part they cut out to make the hole. I'm glad they make them into their own special treat.

I love this place, the food is good and the drinks are even better. I never make it beyond the bar area.  I always end up eating at the bar so I can not speak of the table service.   I hate to make this call out, but anyone who goes here for Happy Hour or anytime for that matter knows it is a true "meat market" and it does not matter which team you play for. So this makes for a very fun and festive night.

This bread co is my go to before work. I recently changed work locations and am now stationed directly across the street. I'm thrilled that they open early. I usually arrive between 6:30 & 6:45AM, so I can easily be at work at 7.   Arriving early the pastries and bagels are filled to the brim and ready to go. My morning order varies, but I'll say the orange scone is my favorite.  I also, enjoy their dark roast coffee.   The customer service at this location in my opinion is better then the one close to my home in STL and it is much larger. The morning staff is always friendly and remind me about what rewards I have available.   This new food relationship is off to a good start.   Chances of returning: Sun-Tue, you'll find me here.  When: Every Sun-Tue Why: My morning cup of joe

Living Room - Southhampton is a great addition to my hood. It is also a great use of the bar space in Craft Beer Cellars in the early morning hours.   LR serves coffee, other morning specialty beverages and a variety of pastries. They're open 7 AM till 1 PM, six days a week. They're closed on Sunday, so you'll have to go over and visit their location in Maplewood.  My favorite latte is the, Salted Honey. It's the perfect combination of sweet and salty all combined in my morning coffee. My other favorite morning drink is, Britt's Cold Brew.   Unfortunately they do not offer the same delicious hot breakfasts that are available at the Maplewood location. However, they do have the same delicious pastries. I love their scones. I have even tried the gluten-free cookies and they're equally as delicious.   The staff are hipster barista's. They're friendly and take great pride in the preparation of your morning drink.   I'll be back? - Yes, I support my local hood.   When: July 10, 2018 Why: Hot new coffee shop in my hood.

Great pizza! I love thin crust and this is one of the best in town. The toppings are plentiful and the hot chicken wings are great too. Delivery is quick and the staff is friendly. This is our favorite place for a quick meal when we're not up to cooking after a work day.

It's a Walgreens and actually one of the better ones within the city. The selection of items is also larger and most extensive then the other Walgreens I frequently shop.   As stated by Shawn M., this is a very busy location. The staff moves the number of customer in and out quickly. I just wish they did it with more finesse. I would rather have better customer service, then to be moved in and out of a store like a bunch of cattle.   I like this store, I will continue to shop here, I just want friendlier customer service when I'm here.

Selection for those of us who wear a wide shoe is limited.   Also, the prices are not that reduced. To get the best deals you need to be member of their rewards program. If you have a normal sized foot, sign up for their rewards and you'll save. Those of us who have wide feet, need to shop else where.   I'll be back? - I'll check back periodically to see if they have my size.   When? - June 13, 2019 Why? - Shopping with a friend

Meet cousins here after the Sunday Cards game. They attended the game, we just meet them for the after game festivities.  Let's make this simple:  Our beer was great after all it is Schlafly's. So enough said.  Not much in variety when it came time to order food. Those eating basically stayed with a "Bison" theme.  Bison Burgers and Bison Nachos. All dining, said they enjoyed their food. My young cousin who had not experienced Bison before even enjoyed his. My experience here, is they put out the best Bison in the city.   I was happy to find a new member to my list, "Dry My Hands". Yes, this location has  Dyson Airblade Hand Dryers.

Color me surprised, another new QT has opened up in the city. Quick Trip is becoming like Walgreens and Starbucks. It almost seems that there is one on every corner. Or at least every other block. This QT is a prime location - it has easy access on and off of 44 and is just a hop, skip and a jump from 64/40.   I'm driving to work earlier then most people get up for work and a convenience market is important to me. It may be a gas station, but their selection and variety of coffee satisfies my need for caffeine. This new location is one that has the kitchen in the center, I can't wait to try it. However, for now I can tell you, if you need a quick breakfast their 99¢ Sausage Biscuit will hit the spot and fill the void.   The staff seems to be friendly and professional and if they can do that in the wee hours of the morning - they've got a good team.   Will I return? Yes - I've fallen out of love with my current gas station and convenience store.   When: March 25, 2017 Why: It's new and I needed coffee.

Ted, it has been two years since my original review and figured I needed to give you an update. I am glad I waited till now and did not do it last fall. At that point, you were starting to lose me as a fan, but this season you are on a strong A-Game.   Your custard is rich, creamy and can be turned upside down without any consequences. I have even been able to turn mine upside down after a 2 mile drive home.  I've tried other flavors, but I will always be true to my M & M's  being my favorite.   I also want to commend you on your staff. Your front window employees are always friendly and know how to move the line quickly. Then  I wonder how those who make the sweet treats, how they can turn them so fast. Your custard truly is a treat of Saint Louis and Route 66.

Note: This review is about the meeting rooms - no overnight stay was done by me.   My work was having a special training class and the size of attendees exceeded the capacity of our in house conference room. We shopped around for a meeting room and since when we have employees from out-of-town visiting STL, we use this Holiday Inn, they gave us a good deal.   The table and chairs they provided were comfortable and accommodating to our needs. Most importantly, was the sound. With all the meeting rooms in the hallway being in use, there was no distractions of hearing what was going on in the other rooms.   My co-workers who came in from other cities and had to stay over-night in the rooms - I heard no complainants.   If you work in the area and need a small to larger meeting room for your business or organization, this HI can fill your needs.

This is not my regular Schnucks. However, whenever I am heading home from Costco and cutting down Loughborough to Hampton, I stop by for items I just cannot buy in bulk at the warehouse store for a single man.   In my original review, which is now several years old, I complained about the produce department. Wow, things have really changed. I will now say this is one of the better produce departments in STL. It's always fresh, organized and well stocked.  I've also gotten use to the lay-out and can shop the aisles with ease. Another area that is pretty good, is the butcher counter. Give me those pork steaks for that backyard grilling.   The staff has done a full Three-Sixty on their attitudes. Even during this pandemic when everyone seems to be on the edge, they were upbeat and positive.  While shopping during the COVID pandemic, I felt safe with all the safety precautions this store had in place.   Will I return? - For, sure.   When: June 4, 2020 Why: Grocery items I cannot buy in bulk.

Thank goodness there is practically a Walgreens on every other block, because this one is so discombobulated. It is cluttered, kind of dirty, in serious need of some TLC and has nil customer service.  I was expecting so much more being located in the Brentwood area, but once inside the store it might as well been in a ghetto. Management, you may have a high volume sales store, but do not let the small details get out of control. If this location was the one closest to my home or work, I'd switch over to CVS or drive to the next closest Walgreens. After all, there is practically one every other block.   Also, be aware of the self important people backing out of parking spaces and arriving in the parking lot while talking on their cell phones. It makes for some defensive driving and a new addition to my Parking Lot Derby list.

Brad and I meet up with Mary Kate A here for a Martini and gab session. I was pleased to see this place is still amazing after all these years. It is a small charming neighborhood bar that serves a quality Martini or Cosmopolitan. I am sure they offer typical bar drinks, but i don't know why you'd order them when the Martini's are creative, go down oh so well and are reasonably priced.   I think this is the great place to go with friend(s) to to relax and have a quality "cocktail". Our bartender was charming, cute and attentive to our alcoholic needs. I'll be back.

I am more of a doughnut guy, but how you spell it doesn't really matter. Because, these are some of the best tasting cake donuts I have had in the St. Louis metropolitan area. They are moist and the icing is not overly sweet. As Goldilocks would say, " These donuts, are just right."   The price point is a little higher then your normal doughnut shop, but lower than the area "gourmet' and "trendy" doughnut shops. Either way you look at it, it is well worth the money. The creative doughnuts with added toppings like M&M's is done way better here, than at other shops in the area.  One of the highlights for me being a dog daddy, is they also offer house-made dog treats. With today being, Love Your Pet Day, I couldn't resist stocking up on a very extra treats for my Fur-Babies.   The staff is friendly and the owner himself is a delight to speak with. He made selecting and buying donuts fun.   When: February 20, 2021 Why: Needed a doughnut and killing time.

It's been three years since my last update for Bono's Pizzeria and I am still a fan.  The other day I stopped by to take advantage of their lunch special. It's a 10" single topping pizza, house salad and a soda for $7.55.  This special is offered Monday thru Friday between the hours of 11 AM till 3 PM. Damn, it was good and I was surprised how big the 10" pizza was. I had enough left over, to enjoy later as a snack and two slices cold for breakfast the next day.   I like how fresh everything is at Bono's. They make the pizza dough, sauce and salad dressings daily in house. You'll taste the freshness. Also, a lot of the recipes were brought over from Sicily by Tony's great-grandmother. History and freshness, makes for a tasty lunch.   The service is always friendly and one of the Tony's is always present.   It doesn't matter if you; dine-in, carry-out or have it delivered. You'll have a great meal from Bono's.   Will I return? Yes, I support my neighborhood businesses.   When: January 30, 2017 Why: Lunch - I deserve pizza

I always have a basic cone when experiencing a new custard place. That way I can get a true flavor of the custard before adding ingredients  to make a sundae or concrete. The custard here was thick, creamy and no flavor.  When I returned to my car, I saw the "Colombo" sign in their window, which is a kiss of death in my book. Colombo is a pre-mix used by many small ice cream business and I have yet to see one produce a quality product.   What a disappointment, I really needed a new place for concretes.

This is one of my favorite nursery's in St. Louis. It is  my place of choice to find flowers and greenery for our planter sconces and hanging baskets.  The plants here just seem to be more hearty and healthier.  I think it is from the TLC they get from the staff.   The staff is very knowledgeable, and can make recommendations to meet your yards needs. We described the amount of shade and sunlight we receive and ideas flowed.   The indoor shop is very cool, lot's of great gifts for any gardner on you gift list.   Spring has arrived, I can't wait to go and make my annual pilgrimage to Garden Heights.  Another bonus,  Mr. Wizard is down the street so treat yourself to a cone while you browse the plants or as a reward for a job well done.

This KFC is very close to my work and convenient for a quick lunch when I have forgotten, or didn't have time to pack a lunch. It is not a full menu KFC, it is an KFC Express. Its' limited menu offers; wings, tenders and popcorn chicken. It also offers Chicken Little Sandwiches, salads and fries. Yes, I would like a full regular chicken dinner with their cole slaw & mashed potatoes, but this menu does the trick when I'm hungry.   It's tucked inside the small food court located inside the Gateway Station downtown. At times, the lines can be long due to the arrival and departure of buses and trains, but the crew moves the lines quickly. My food has always been hot and fresh. The staff has a positive attitude, which can be a challenge when dealing with stressed or rushed travelers.   Will I return? Yep, it's a good quick lunch when I need it.   When: Numerous times. Why: Work lunch

The loveseat in my entertainment room is ready for retirement. It definitely has seen better days and needs to go away. I've periodically heard the radio commercials for Mueller Furniture on Y-98 and thought I'd give them a visit.  I was totally impressed with the variety of selection and the affordability of price. Kay my sales associate was knowledgeable of the merchandise and offered several suggestions to meet my needs. She was totally professional. She helped me find two items that fit my needs and budget.   However, after completing my Labor Day shopping, I put the retirement of the loveseat off for a couple more months. When it is time, I will be returning to Mueller Furniture and talking to Kay one more time.   Savings Note: If you buy in IL and have delivered to MO - you pay no sales tax.  When: September 6, 2016 Why: Need new loveseat

The staff here is very knowledgeable and eager to help their customers. We explained what we wanted to create, our sun exposure and our color preferences. Our sales associate guided us through our selections and even helped draw out the placement of the perennials in our fence sconces. Their customer service is outstanding and their love for plants shows.  If anyone needs perennials or annuals for their yard, I would highly recommend Garden Heights Nursery.

Let me repeat my opening line from my review back in 2013, "The staff here is very knowledgeable and eager to help their customers." Seven years later, this is still true. The customer service here, is truly the gold standard.   My dogs nanny, gifted me with two beautiful African Violets. I found the perfect spot in my sun-room for them to be inside and have ample light. However, I do not have a green thumb. I watered them and I may have over watered. They shriveled up and I was losing them.   I was besides myself, I wanted to save them. Due to the pandemic, Garden Heights was closed and I could not get the assistance I needed at Home Depot or Lowe's. When GHN finally opened, I headed over immediately for help. Told them my situation and they knew the solution. They recommended a self-watering pot for my violets and they are flourishing now.   In addition to the great customer service, GHN is practicing safe social distancing and enforcing a face mask for customers and staff policy.   Will I return? - Yes!  When: June 27, 2020 Why: Self-Watering Pot Shopping

Big disappointment, it started out with poor customer service. The staff was just rude, and could careless that we were there. We ordered an 8 piece box with biscuits and large side and an extra large side. Our order was carry out and when we got home, we realized they shorted us our second large side. Then when we opened our box of chicken, 4 of the 8 pieces were legs. Stopping by the next day, to mention the shortage of a large side, we were told we should have come back that same night, that it was to late now.  All they had to do is say sorry, and they couldn't even do that. Our chicken business will be going somewhere else.

I'm giving this Schnucks 5 Stars, simply because they had what i needed and wanted. One of my main Christmas gifts was a bottle of Rye from the local distillery, Switchgrass. Living in Illinois now, Switchgrass is not available. It is not distributed there yet. Hope they come soon.   Any how, the liquor department at this store was impressive. They had plenty of the Switchgrass offering and had the Rye, that I wanted so badly. Honestly, it should be a 4 Star rating, but they had an associate working the alcohol aisle and that made me much it up a star.   Love, Rye? Want to support local? Buy, Switchgrass.

My momma raised me right. When ever you get a gift, you send a thank-you card. I recently celebrated the 32nd Anniversary of my 29th Birthday and received some very special and unique gifts. So in turn, I thought it was only appropriate that I send some very special and unique cards.  Hallmark was not an option. I needed the best from a local source, so I headed over to, The Firecracker Press.   The variety of note with STL themes were nice. However, I found two cards that were designed as a Thank-you card and they served my purpose very well. I did see other cards that caught my eye and I will return for another occasion.   Then to my surprise, when I got home and reached into my bag. TFP had given me a little thank-you postcard. It entitled me to 10% off on my next web purchase. I'm more of a brick and mortar shopper, but to save 10%, I can shop the web.   Will I return? - Yes, here and the web.   When: November 17, 2017 Why: Thank-you Cards

A delightful little florist shop. I discovered it on Small Business Saturday when I was shopping at Four Muddy Paws, next door. The staff was so friendly and helpful. They made me feel so welcomed in their flower and gift shop.   While shopping, I was able to find a yard flag holder and a holiday flag to start my collection of flags.  I have always wanted one of these and when I moved into my new house,  most of my neighbors all had them. So, I thought it was time to take the plunge and make the purchase. I'm glad it was from a local small business and not a chain or mail-order. I also, purchased a new ornament for my Christmas tree. You can never have too many holiday decorations.  I'm hosting my family Christmas dinner this year, so I plan on having Wildflower doing my centerpiece. Don't worry, my gathering will  be within the CDC guidelines.   Will I return? - Yep!   When: November 28, 2020 Why: Small Business Saturday

I'll give them 3 Stars, because I like West Elm. However, I gotta tell you the customer service here was zero. Both associates stayed seated at the center desk and did not greet me as I circled the showroom twice.   Another customer entered the store with a mail-order return and one of the associates got up and assisted her at the front of the store. As I passed the seated associate for my third time, she finally asked me how I was doing. I replied, "I'm fine, thank-you." I then exited the store and went home and placed an on-line order for what I wanted.   I prefer brick and mortar over on-line shopping, but customer service like this is what pushed me to the internet.   Will I return? - I'll give them another try.   When: March 5, 2020 Why: Saw something I wanted in my Facebook Feed

Excellent customer service and excellent pricing. When I did a gut rehab of my kitchen, I shopped here for an estimate. They beat every other estimate, including the company who was doing the remodel.   I got all new stainless steel appliances,  and they all had rebates which made the deal even sweeter. I love'm all.  With a gut rehab, I needed a small refrigerator  and freezer to get through me through the weeks of no kitchen. They also, made me a great package price on these items.   I recommend this appliance store over any Big Box store. You'll get true personalized service.

Having a baby shower at work for a male employee who is a Cardinal fan? Let me tell you what the best gift ever, is. It's a stuffed bear or pup in a St. Louis Cardinal uniform from Build-A-Bear. Being a dog lover, I went for the Chocolate Chunk Pup. I named him, Yadi.   The stuffed pup may have to sit on the shelf until the newborn is older, but it was a major hit and favorite gift of the dad.   Build-A-Bear is a great hometown company that allows you to create a special toy for that child or adult who has everything and needs a new companion. Check it out. Perhaps you need a new friend, too.   Staff was friendly and helpful. As an adult purchaser, they weren't totally turned on as I have seen them with children creating their new friend. Which was just fine with me.   Will I return? - Next baby shower for sure.   When: Sometime in 2017 Why: Gift for a baby shower

Do you love STL? Or perhaps you know someone who loves, STL. If you answered yes to either of statements, this is the store for you.   Everything here shouts, STL. You'll find caps, hoodies, T-Shirts, mugs and much more branded with St. Louis, STL or a  simple Fleur-de-lis. I absolutely loved it. I bought several ornaments for holiday gifts and a cap and mug for myself.   The shop pops up on you faster then you'd think on Brentwood, so be prepared. Also, there are limited parking spaces in front, but there are some along the side and back. Hope and pray that you get one in front.   Will I return? - Do I love, STL?  When: December 4, 2020 Why: Christmas Gifts and Gift Bag for YEE

1-800-Got-Junk is what it is and what it is, is a life saver. Some may say, they are a rip-off and over-priced. I say, they are worth every penny. Their staff is professional, polite and clean-cut. The ones doing my job, truly were the boy next door types. The trucks are well maintained and extremely clean for being trucks designated for hauling junk.   Why would I pay someone to haul away my junk? My free time is very valuable to me and I don't have any friends who own pick up trucks. Plus, I'd have to research where to dispose of my unwanted items and sometimes you need permits for proper disposal. Got Junk, takes care of all of that for me and when they can, they recycle.   It's easy to schedule an appointment. They truly do come when it is convenient for you. So, don't keep living with that junk you hate - call 1-800-Got-Junk and start living your life junk free. You'll be glad that you did.   When: September 27, 2016 Why: I had junk

Love me some Mississippi Mud Pottery!   I've received a couple of gifts from MMP and have truly enjoyed them. I use them when entertaining guest and as an decorative accent when there is no party in the house. I like the Mixed Berry pattern, it has a rich red tone and a masculine feel to its' design.  In fact I like it so much I have gone myself and added additional pieces to my collection.  The staff is very friendly and it is cool that you can view an artists working right there in the showroom. Another thing that I think makes them unique, is that a couple getting married can pick or design their own pattern and have it registered for gifts.  Almost makes me want to get married just for the pottery. Just kidding, I'd marry for money first.  So next time you go to Fast Eddies or the Loading Dock in Grafton, stop by MMP and get some amazing pottery.

I am so glad Wellspent Brewing is back open in the Lou. I was also surprised to see that their old check-in on Yelp was gone. When I checked in, all that popped up was this new one. Either way, I am thrilled they are back and considering the large standing room only crowd, I am not the only one.   The Wellspent brewery is small, compact and cozy. There are several stools at the bar, multiple tables and several high-tops as well. In addition to all the indoor seating, WB has a relaxing patio. While I was there for the Grand Opening, several patrons enjoying cigars outside. In addition to stogie smokers, there were also some K-9's enjoying the re-opening with their owners.   Great locally brewed beer, friendly staff and K-9 friendl. Welcome back to the local craft beer scene, Wellspent.   When: February 15, 2020 Why: Grand Re-Opening

I'll give them 3 Stars, because they're a QT. However, this is my least favorite Quik Trip in STL. It is totally crazy in the parking lot and at times unsafe.   Why unsafe? Other customers are not paying attention to the surroundings and driving like they are competing in a Stock car demolition derby. Also, on my most recent visit, I was hassled by two different homeless people. Typically, I am one who helps and gives them a buck or two or take them inside and treat them to what they want. However, on this day, I was uncomfortable.  So uncomfortable, that I left and never even made it into the QT. They lost a sale of gas and snacks.   Great location!

I'll try to make this one simple.  Pros  New (fairly) Convenient  location - next to my favorite Lowe's & 55 too.  Clean and well kept.  Cons  Unfriendly staff - actually rude Poor lay-out Selection not the same as other Schnucks Poor produce  Hey Schnucks, how can you get it so right at one location and miss it at another? This location should be a gold mine.

What a great little gift shop located on the heart of Main Street in Edwardsville. It is eclectic and full of unique and vintage gifts. It is a great place to shop for the person who has everything. The selection is so unusual and creative, your gift will be remembered and cherished forever.   This little shop was a pleasant discovery while we were having lunch at Cleveland-Heath. It is the type of store you'd expect to find on an antique row. It would fit in perfectly on Cherokee Street in St. Louis on in the historic downtown of St. Charles.   I'm not an early holiday shopper, but stopping by The August Garden (name is wrong on Yelp), I have already marked a couple people off my list.

Yes it is a chain, but I like their crust and sauce so I will let Pappa in my house.   I've recently gotten burned out on my hometown pizza delivery joints and have started to revisit the national chains. Papa was the first and he delivered us a good pie. I hop on-line, built our own pizza with Spicy Sausage, Onion, Green Pepper and Baby Portabella Mushrooms. I then entered my payment information and clicked the final button. Thirty minuets later, we had a flavorful pizza at our door.   I use to be a BIG fan of thin crust pizza, but I am slowly leaning and appreciating a thicker pie crust. Imo's may claim that their toppings extend to the edge of the pizza, but I love Papa's crust and the Garlic Dipping Sauce they include with your pizza. Yummy.   Papa and I may not see eye to eye on politics, but we are eye to eye on his pizza.

It is a gas station, nothing more nothing less. However, it has saved my ass  many times when my gas gage has been down to one bar and I'm scared I wont make it much further. This scenario happens more then I'd like to admit. It is easily accessible from Interstate 44. You can get off, fill up and get back on the road with ease. The prices are relatively competitive, considering the prime location. You'd think they'd be  higher considering the convenience.  As others have commented, the convenience market is extremely small. It is about the size the of a shipping container. It may be small and compact, but they make good use of every available inch for merchandising. Unfortunately when I have gone in to shop, I've walked out empty handed. Due the the smallness, the variety of products is limited.   I'm a pay at the pump customer, so I've only gone inside to interact with the staff a few times. However I must say, the automated gas pumps always thanks me for shopping.

Had to increase my stars from three to four today.   We stopped by today to get some of their house made Salsiccia sausage for pasta - it is fantastic.   The customer service here is always friendly and outstanding. They were smoking ribs in the parking lot today and they smelled like heaven. I'm sure it attracts many customers. Come on spring, I'm ready to start grilling regularly again.

"You're going to like the way you look" may no longer be their catch phrase, but I liked the way I looked at an Old Hollywood party I attended for Yelp and it was all thanks to the staff at Men's Wearhouse and Tux.   I stopped by about a week ahead of the special event, to see what styles were available. The tux specialist was very knowledgable in sizing and what would be appropriate for my Hollywood party. I was up front with my associate, telling her this was just a fun party and I wanted to go lower-end, but still look good. She totally understood and fixed me up in a fashionable Calvin Klein. When it came time to pick my accessories, I told her they had to be orange. After all, orange is the new black and it is my favorite color. The orange vest and tie, made the tux scream me.   If you need a tuxedo for a special event or a wedding, I highly recommend MWAT. They are way better then Savvi Formalwear in the Loop. When you shop here, ask for Jasmine, she is an amazing.

Thanks Sugarfire Smoke House for making my Memorial Day lunch a success. The 10 oz Brisket Sandwich was a true classic and your Brisket Cheesesteak put all Philly Cheesesteaks to shame. Philadelphia should be scared.   We shared four sides; Potato Salad, Baked Beans, Creamy Cole Slaw and Pasta Salad. The portions were so huge, we took most of them home to enjoy with the Brats we grilled at home that evening. However, we ate every bite of our sandwiches. I truly love your cole slaw and baked beans. I'd love the recipe for both, but know I'll never get them.   No matter how busy and slammed you are, your staff is always friendly. They  take the time to make sure all diners are greeted appropriately and make small talk as place your order. I always feel welcomed, which in addition to the great food is why I keep coming back for more. Give me some Sugarfire!

What a deal, buy 8" and get another 8" free. I found a Entertainment Coupon that was a Buy One - Get One Free and that is a deal you just can not pass up.  We ordered a Italian and a Chicken Parmesan. Once home, we cut the 8" in half so we each got to experience both. Tonight the Chicken Parmesan was the winner. A chicken breast and pizza sauce with other garnishes, make for a tasty sandwich.   Their fries are some of the best in fast food. Big Idaho potatoes, freshly cut with skins left on and deep fried to a crispy treat. A large order is sufficient enough for two to share. To wash it all down, a gallon of their fresh squeezed is the perfect beverage. Normally, I love Penn Stations lemonade, but this time it was way too sweet. I'll forgive them this time.   Staff is always friendly and you can watch them make your order. While you are waiting be sure to sign up their e-mail alerts, you'll get special discount announcements.

Friar Tuck came to my rescue. I was on a search for a particular Bloody Mary mix and they had it. When I recently went to Washington, MO for a day trip I discovered, Tony's Sweet Heat Bloody Mary Mix. I wanted to add it to a gift box I was creating for someone and really wanted to avoid having to make the trip back to Wash MO to buy another bottle.   Oh, did I mention Tony's is a local brand? It is, it is......Fenton, MO.   I visited Tony's website and found out who carried it locally. I tried to buy it from small local shops, but they were all out (tells me how good it is), so I had to buy it from a BIG chain. However, I will say the price was $2 lower then what I paid in Washington, MO. Also, I was surprised by the attentiveness and friendliness of sales associates assisting on the floor.  The cashier was even a pleasant asset to the store.   Will I return? - They rescued me once, I bet they do it again.   When: December 13, 2017 Why: On a Mission

Need a fast breakfast? Go to Bread Co., it is far better then a sausage  biscuit from a fast food place.  The breakfast sandwiches are totally awesome, as are the small quiches.  We can never make up our minds so we share several items to get a taste of our favorites. We'll share a sandwich, quiche and a scone (for something sweet).   The customer service here is down home friendly. I'd highly recommend this be the location used for training the staffs of other STL Bread Co's.  My only negative of this location is that they are putting in a drive-up window.  I know it's weird, but I just don't like drive-up windows. I prefer to park, go inside and experience true customer service in person and not through a speaker box and window.

Larder and Cupboard is another great addition to the constantly growing Maplewood community. I knew I was going to shop local this upcoming holiday, but I can now tell you the majority of my gifts will be from Larder and Cupboard. There are so many items that will be perfect for the foodie and boozer on my gift list.   My family and friends who enjoy the alcohol beverage, may be getting a gift box of bitters or a kit to create a kick ass Bloody Mary. Others may get a gift basket created with the large variety of different honey jars. My personal favorite has to be the Hot Honey, a perfect topping on cornbread or a biscuit. I can even create a condiment basket with gourmet catsup, Soy Sauce, Worcestershire Sauce and variety of mustards.   The staff is friendly and eager to assist you. As they increase their inventory, I am confident that I'll be filling my own personal kitchen cabinets and creating several gift baskets.

I live in the city and drive all the way out to West County to visit this vet. That in itself, should tell you this is an incredible vet. The entire staff is professional and very caring. I have three Shelties and they have a true understanding of the breed, so I know they are getting the best care possible.  A vet that provides good TLC.

Understand this review is based on a carry-out order.   I stopped by Four Muddy Paws yesterday to pick up food for my fur-babies, and found a new place for a lunch. No, not Four Muddy Paws, Square One Brewery which is just down the street.   I checked to see if they did carry-out and then persuaded my co-workers to change things up and order from somewhere new. We'll be ordering again soon...  Here's how they earned their stars:  1. Friendly Service 2. Eco-Friendly carry-out containers 3. Take-out ready when promised 4. Great Food! We loved the Beer Battered Onion Rings, Ruben and the Chicken Jerk Sandwich.  This was carry-out done well!!

I am not a fan of Subway, but I am a fan of Potbelly. They know how to make a fresh sandwich fast and with friendly customer service.  We were running errands in Creve Coeur and just wanted a quick lunch. What can be quicker then 8 minutes? Potbelly promotes that you'll be through their line in 8 minutes max. I have no idea what happens if it does take longer. With the speed they move, I don't think it would ever happen.   We enjoyed an Italian and the Wreck, both were very enjoyable. What sets Potbelly above their competitors is the ratio of ingredients to bread. The sandwiches here are not overpowered by bread like they are at Subway. The ingredients are the true star.    I wish we had a Potbelly in city, but I'm glad we don't. If I had one closer to my house, I'd have a Potbelly from eating so much Potbelly. What would make Potbelly a 5 Star is if they had fries like Penn Station. Now that would be an awesome fast lunch.

New and improved. Heritage Veterinary Hospital has moved across the street to a fabulous new location. They have built a state of the art facility to match the excellent service they provide to canines and felines.  To make sure my previous review from their original location transfers over, I am going to cheat with a cut & paste:    I live in the city and drive all the way out to West County to visit this vet. That in itself, should tell you this is an incredible vet. The entire staff is professional and very caring. I have three Shelties and they have a true understanding of the breed, so I know they are getting the best care possible.  A vet that provides good TLC.

The original needs to watch out, this new location is fantastic.  Our service was fast and friendly. The menu selection is a little smaller then South Grand location, but they put out some good diner food.  I live in between the two locations, and I may now find myself preferring the Fox diner over the original.

I am so glad this location finally opened near my work. I use to drive to work the opposite direction to the Maplewood location (I live in the Lindenwood Park), then back track into the city for work. My work day begins at 5 AM so, I like a place that is open 24 hours, so I can start my day with a fresh cup of black coffee and a breakfast treat.   If someone asked me what my favorite donut is, I'd have to reply.....a donut hole. With that being said, I am a huge fan of the TimBits. A variety box of 10 and I'm as excited as a little kid on Halloween night.  If I need something more savory, I order a Bagel B.E.L.T.. I have yet to see any fast food restaurant make a breakfast sandwich as good as Tim Hortons.   I admit the drive-thru is a little crazy at this location, but it works and gets me on my way.  The staff is always chipper and friendly in the mornings. Tim Hortons makes my mornings easier.   When: Early AM Thursday-Sunday Why: Coffee and a morning treat

Another great spot on Main Street in Saint Chuck for picking up goodies to create gift baskets. Or better yet, mixes and goodies to help you look like a shining star at the holiday party.   If you are looking for gift ideas, for that friend or family member who is always in the kitchen this is the place to shop. You will come out with all sorts of spices, glazes and marinades.  I was amazed at the huge selection of Hot Sauces. Who knew there are so many ways to get heartburn.   Pat C. is right,  there are so many options, that a cook could get dizzy.   Bad Byron's Butt Rub! I had to buy it just for the name.

My annual update to tell you how cool and wonderful this little shop in Soulard is. It always makes my holiday shopping easy and I have some difficult people to shop for. It doesn't matter if they are on the nice or naughty list, you'll find an appropriate gift here. The gifts I find are unique, affordable and always received with excitement from the recipient.   This year, one of my recipients said, "I bet you got this at, The Porch." I just sat there with a Cheshire Cat grin on my face.   So I encourage you to shop local in one of the most historical neighborhoods in Saint Louis. Once you are done shopping at The Porch, treat yourself to some BBQ or Tacos across the street. You'll be eating local as well.  Will I return? - I always do......  When: November 28, 2017 Why: It's that most wonderful time of the year

The Cinnamon  Rolls at Amy's are scrumptious. They are gooey, soft, loaded with big flavor and proof that size does not matter. The are small  in size, but big on flavor. Even though they are smaller, I am sure the calorie count is something I really do not want to know.   They're an incredible value at $1.25. What makes them even more special is when you order,  they ask if you want a center piece or an edge piece. I've had both and they both taste the same, but some who those inner center ones just seem to be softer and more gooier.  If it were a brownie, I'd take an edge piece.   I've also stopped in for a weekend breakfast and enjoyed big cup of Kaldi's coffee with an order of Biscuits and Gravy. The portion is small, but plentiful. Their House made biscuits are covered in a light brown milk gravy filled with large chunks of sausage.   Amy and her staff are always a delight to chat with while you are ordering. If you dine in, the great open space gives you the opportunity to watch them create their sweet baked goods.

Friday we ordered Chicken Wings and Double order of Fries for the crew at work. Everyone was amazed at the wings. The wings were hot & spicy and the sauce was not over whelming. I hate wings that you have to wipe your fingers and mouth after every bite.   The fries were like baby steak fries, they were crisp and seasoned well. When I create a list of the best french fries, they'll be on the list.

It was late at night, I was working overtime covering the midnight shift at work and needed food. Not much was open at such an ungodly hour. The service was quick, the food was hot and fresh.  I was impressed that the lot was pretty much litter free, which is impressive considering its downtown location. Normally I do not use a drive-thru window, so I was shocked with the speedy and polite service I received. I had a good giggle while in line for the drive-thru, the car ahead of me was actually a golf cart. He was a security guard from a nearby nightclub.   Not my typical WC, but I'd come back for a slider or two.

I've just showered with a glycerin soap from Maven and "I feel pretty, oh, so pretty, I feel pretty, witty and bright".  I will admit, I have always used two soaps when showering. I use a deodorant soap for the manly areas and a Dove for Men product for the rest of my body. After this shower, I am flipping that bird off and replacing it with the locally made soap from Maven.   The scent I bought on my first visit was, "my boyfriends t-shirt". I can assure you it does not smell like the t-shirts of the Sharks and Jets after they have been dancing on the rooftops and streets of New York City.  In stead it smells like fresh clean laundry that has dried in a fresh summer breeze. The fragrance was so soothing that I also bought it in a Wood Wick Soy Candle and Solid Perfume.   I can tell you now, I will be a repeat customer at Maven. I may even have to start considering myself to be a metro sexual, which I have not in the past.

I am still amazed how good the customer service is at this store. The staff is always friendly, helpful and go beyond the normal retail associate. It is also well maintained and merchandised.   Did you know that if you find a "published" lower price on an item sold at PetSmart that they will match it? I didn't, but I found that out today and wanted to share that with my fellow pet owners on Yelp.

For those of you who are early risers, it is time for you to take advantage of the Early Bird Special at City Diner. Every day except holidays, between 7 & 9 AM, CD offers one of the best values in the city.  $4 will get you two eggs prepared how you like them, a choice of bacon or sausage, hash browns or American Fries and toast. That is a lot of food for $4.   This morning we took advantage of the Early Bird special and shared a half order of Biscuits & Gravy. A half order is only one biscuit topped in gravy for $3 and a full order is two biscuits for $4.50. The biscuit was HUGE, when split in half it is plenty for two to share. Add your typical morning beverage and you have a great feast to start your day.  I've never been disappointed with the service here, it is always friendly. Even when it is your first visit they make you feel as if you are a regular.

The Customer Service here is amazing. They are friendly, have positive attitudes and project a team spirit. Your order is made right in front of you, so you know it's going to be good. Having all of that, you get quality service and food. The fresh cut fries are great and the hand squeezed lemonade is the best. If you can wait till you get home, a splash of Vodka in the lemonade gives it an extra kick. I've tried multiple sandwiches and all of them are yummy, but the Philly Cheesesteak is still a favorite. When you leave, the positive energy here will have you leaving with a smile - hence a "Happy Meal".

Watching the other diners is like watching the characters from Tales of the City. It is entertaining and makes for great conversation. The food is above average for a diner. Breakfast is by far their best meal. The service is way better then Alice and Flo at Mel's Diner. Get out and experience city life and have breakfast at City Diner.

Great addition to The Grove. Gezellig is an amazing Beer Hall that offers a large variety of craft beers. You have an impressive amount of draft beers and a enormous selection of can and bottles. If you cannot find a beer to satisfy your taste buds, you need to be drinking whiskey up the street at Intoxicology.   The bartenders or the masters of craft beer are very helpful and personable. During my visit, I enjoyed two flights, each was 3, 5 oz samplings of different beers. I selected the first flight and allowed the bartender to surprise me with the second. I shared with him, my typical likes and dislikes and he magically created a flight that was to my liking.   What makes Gezellig unique to other beer bars, is the variety. It's impressive that you can not only enjoy a cold draft beer, but you can go to the coolers and select a bottle or can to enjoy as well. If you find one you really like, buy it and take it home too.   I'll be back? - Yes, it is a craft beer paradise.   When: March 7, 2018 Why: Meeting Yelp friends for a cold beer.

Great place, I have never been disappointed. The staff is friendly and provide great service. The Ari's Greek Salad is big enough for two to share and then some. If you're sharing a Ari's Salad, share an order of Flaming Cheese...YUM! Breakfast on the weekend, for $6.95, it is the best value in the city. I can not sing the praises enough of the breakfast buffet at Ari's. It is simple, filling and worth the $. The made to order omelets are huge and stuffed with the items of your choice. Make it a true weekend brunch and enjoy a Bloody Mary

This is where used car salesman got their sleazy reputation.   I wouldn't shop or buy anything from this location.   After leaving had to go home and shower to get rid of the sleazy grime feeling that I got from their sales manager and staff.   We caught them in a bald face lie and the more they tried to save face, the more they tripped over their words. It was a prime example of the right hand not knowing what the left had is doing.

OMG! After listening to Mark P. sing the praises of Diana, I finally visited her bakery on our last pilgrimage to Cherokee. We lucked out and got princess parking right in front and were immediately overwhelmed with the aroma when we exited our car.  Entering the bakery definitely smells heavenly and the selection on my first visit was overwhelming.   There was so much to choose from, I didn't know what to experience first I should have paid closer attention to recommendations here on Yelp. I like the idea of picking up a tray and tongs at the front door and filling the tray with your selections it makes the check out easier.   One of the treats we bought was a couple slices of Flan and if I were not trying to lose weight I could of enjoyed another slice. Now that I have discovered Diana, we'll be stopping every time we are on Cherokee.

This place is a hoot. I would have never discovered it if it were not for an Yelp event.  When I described this place to the So, I said it was like the child of a Waffle House and a Yogurt place. You order a waffle and then pick your toppings. How fun is that?  It is personalized just for you.   In addition to waffles, they offer flavorful lattes too. Their "Hair of the Dog" caught my eye. It's a fun take on Bloody Mary's, but in addition to Vodka, you can select your booze of choice as well. The fun doesn't end there, you can have a tall PBR in a brown bag. Appropriately called, "The Brown Bagger".  Seriously, do you want your friends to know you are drinking a PBR?   The staff is friendly and provides good attention to their guest. The ambiance is just this side of tacky. Afghans cover many of the seats and are even wrapped around the trees outside the restaurant. Are they tacky? Yes, but it adds to the charm of this Patch neighborhood waffle joint.   Want a waffle? Head to Melt and enjoy good times.

A unique store in the heart of Soulard. You can buy home decor, fashion accessories and wine all in one stop and shop. What makes it even better, is that you #shoplocal and #shopsmall.   Every year since I discovered this gift shop back in 2012, it has been one of the first stops for my holiday shopping. I have always been able to check off several people on my list, especially the naughty ones.   If you haven't checked this store out, do so the next time you are eating at Bogarts or Mission Taco. You'll be glad that you did.   Would you come back? Yes, it's one of the best shops for creative gift giving.   When: December 9, 2016 Why: It's that time of year to gift shop.

What a combination, Irish Pub and Fried Chicken and some of the best Fried Chicken in the city. The new spicy flavor gives a extra kick of flavor, but I prefer the original - it's as good as Grandma's. If you're eating fried food, you might as well splurge and have their livers or onion strings too. However, I recommend ordering hot sauce for dipping the livers. They provide cocktail sauce which I just find to be weird. Service is friendly & top-notch for a bar & grill.

Lola Jean's is a heartwarming little coffee shop. It basically is a pop-up, because in the new year it will become Lola Jean's Pizza and I'm looking forward to that switch over.   Right now, LJ is offering the delicious pastries from Russel's on Macklind and enjoy a cup of coffee from local roaster, Kaldi. What makes this little coffee shop so heartwarming is the fact that the profits from each month are donated to a local charity.   Bring a friend, relax and catch up on each others lives. Or, you can bring your laptop and catch up on that work you've putting off. You can do both of these things, in a very peaceful and relaxing atmosphere.   The menu is small, but keep in mind all the profits are giving back to our community.   I'll be back? - YES!  When: November 18, 2018 Why: It's a giveback coffee shop

This station has been open for almost 4 years and so many times gets written up as Amtrak or Greyhound Stations, when actually it is a shared station owned by the city. Saint Louis finally is getting caught up with other major cities and has created a transportation center. It is a station shared by trains, buses and Metro. It makes it easy for travelers to make connections when using multiple types of mass transportation. They can come in from Springfield, IL on Amtrak, hop on Metro to the airport and get a plane to New York and beyond.   I commend the city of Saint Louis for finally creating this type of station. It is centrally located downtown, just across the street from Scottrade Center. The station is open 24 hours and has a security staff and management on duty at all times making it a safe environment for all travelers.

LOVE IT!!!!  What a fantastic addition to the neighborhood.   I will admit that when I first saw the sign for a consignment shop coming, I rolled my eyes. I was not looking forward to a clothing consignment shop. A home furnishing shop is a whole different game.   The selection is great and all the items are in excellent condition. The ladies are very selective on the items they accept, keeping an upscale feel to the shop. They have everything from Love Seats, Leather Chairs, flatware, dining tables, and oh so much more.   Before shopping at Week-Ends Only or Rothmans, check out The Green Goose. Chances are that you will find a better quality item at a cheaper price.   While shopping, we asked if they had specific items and they knew exactly where they were and even was able to do suggestive selling as well. Great customer service in a consignment shop is a major plus!  So next time you are dining at Matthew's Kitchen or getting a Mystic Tan at the Tan Co. stop in and check out the Goose, you'll be glad that you did.

When ever I am in the Alton area and get the craving for custard, I head over to Shiver's for my fix. I especially get the craving when I drive by and see one of my favorite flavors on the marque as the featured flavor. Some how when I see Chocolate Malt, Yellow Cake Batter or Mint Chip on the sign, my car automatically pulls in. With autumn finally here, I can't wait to enjoy one of their Jack-O-Lantern Concretes.   If you're in the Alton area and your sweet tooth kicks in, head up to Godfrey and treat yourself to a frozen treat at Shiver's.

My car blew up and died, right when I was buying a new house and selling mine. The last thing I needed to do was also buy a new car all at the same time. So, I borrowed my cousins pick-up for a couple of months.   When everything had settled down, I took my cousins truck to Auto Butler for a good detailing before returning it.  The staff was friendly, professional and they did an excellent job. I was pleased with the vacuuming, clean windows and tires.  I normally read Yelp reviews before going to a business, but this time I didn't and I am kinda glad I didn't. If I had, I would not have gone. The experience I had was totally different from those posted. I now have my new ride and will be getting my RAV4 detailed here.   Will I return? - Gotta keep the new ride clean.   When: November 25, 2020 Why: Detailing my borrowed ride.

I've never been to The Post late at night, or to watch a sports event. I've only been for lunch and for that it is a winner for me.   Why it is a winner? It is because I can get a big juicy burger with fries and a craft beer or an order of chicken wings - baked for that extra crispiness and a side of fries and of course, a craft beer. Either combination is a perfect lunch for a day off and a break from running errands. The Post is definitely a step up from the typical pub-grub sports bar food.   The service is always attentive and friendly. Sometimes I sit at the bar, but my usual go to is a high-top for two. It's a little more private and allows me a chance to get caught up on my social media.   There's countless number of TV screens, so if you want a bar to watch the big game and have some good food - I'd say, this is a place to go.

Five Below is a budget friendly novelty store. Everything in this store is priced in even dollar amounts and it's all under $5. Hence the name, Five Below.   It's amazing what you can find here. It's kinda like shopping at a TJ Maxx. You need to shop often, because the variety and selection of merchandise is constantly changing. You can find things for yourself, the kids, pets and the home. One of my best finds was a vegetable cookbook.   If you're a movie goer, the candy isle here is a perfect place to stock up on treats to enjoy while viewing the latest blockbuster. Why pay the the high prices at the movie theatre when you can fill your pockets or purse with bargain saving sweets from Five Below.   I'll be back? - See you at the movies.   When: April 23, 2018 Why: Bargain hunting.

Yes they have good sandwiches, but that is not why I visit LeGrand's. I go for their butcher counter and wood chips when it is grilling season.   Next time your in ordering a sandwich, take note of the quality meats and create something of your own.

This review is all about the dog food. Wow! I was totally impressed with the huge variety and selection of dry and canned foods. They offer something for everyone and every budget.   If you buy just your everyday run of the mill dog food that is offered at a lower price point, they've got it for you. If you're the type who is picky, want USA made, grain-free, all natural food for your dog, they've got that for you, too.   The store is well maintained, it's clean, no odor and that is an amazing accomplishment for what I'd call a big box pet retailer.   I also found the staff to be attentive and friendly. My cashier was extremely polite and engaging with all customers.   I'll be back? - A simple, yes.   When: May 28, 2019 Why: Emergency Shop after work.

I'll admit, I am not a fan of RTA furniture. I'll buy it on occasion, but it's not my thing. However, one area that I love about IKEA is their home goods. When I shop their kitchen accessories, I can always find something and it will be at an affordable price.   Another thing that I put in my shopping cart at IKEA is the Cinnamon Rolls. They are so tasty for a weekend breakfast or even better, on Christmas morning.   One thing that IKEA does need to be praised for is their displays. How they tell you the square footage and then show you what can be done is so amazing and creative.   Why: New kitchen gadgets

I'm not a crafty person, but I still shop Michaels on occasion. Today, I found some cute Valentine items to complete the holiday look on my mantel. I even got a couple  of pieces for St. Patrick's Day. They were just starting to put the St. Pat's items out, so I may have to make a return visit.   Not being a craft person, I never know where to look for an item. I totally get lost, but it's easy to find an associate who can guide you. Today, I was looking for a large plate stand and the associate who I asked help from, gave better directions than Siri or Alexa.   What kept them from getting 4 stars, is that this store did not have the selection or variety that the St. Louis stores have. Hopefully, the amount of merchandise is due to the holiday just ending.   When: January 9, 2021 Why: Decorating Mantel for the next holidays

What a great second location for the Green Goose. This larger space allows Robin and her friendly staff to show larger pieces of furniture that the cute smaller shop on Hampton could not accommodate. They have a larger variety of sectional sofas and dining room tables, that would be great for a young couple starting out.  Or that recent college grad furnishing an apartment, after landing a professional job.   If your an empty nester and down sizing, the Green Goose is the place to sell those larger or extra pieces of furniture that will not make the move with you to the new smaller home. You'll not only find a new home for your cherished furniture, but you'll put some extra $'s in your own pocket. Also, while you're selling yours', you just may find an item or two for your new home.   Selling or buying, the new Green Goose is a must stop for decorating a home.   When: September 23, 2013 Why: Always on the look-out for new home furnishings

Ooh, La La. These possibly may be my new favorite macarons.   I recently moved from STL city to the IL side and this past week-end had a few friends over for dinner. When they arrived, they gifted me a box of macarons. So, honestly I must say I have not been to Le Macaron myself, but I can testify that these six macrons rocked my world. When I finally ate the last one, my heart was broken. However, I knew I was going to STL this week for a Yelp event and could swing by Le Macaron and stock up on some more.   Their macarons were just the perfect amount of sweetness and each one had its own distinct flavor. I could easily name each one, without being told what flavor they were.   I can't wait to see their actual space and I'm thrilled that they are in an area that I frequent often.   I highly recommend you check this place out. I know I will, thanks to my friends getting me addicted to these perfectly delicious French delicacies.   When:  July 17, 2021  Why: Gift for hosting dinner party

Boo-Hiss!   I came to celebrate, National Egg McMuffin Day and was totally disappointed. It was a time you'd think they'd have their A-Game going, but they did not. I went through the drive-thru about, 6:45AM.   Since I was there to celebrate their special day and I am sure they're the ones who created it, I ordered the Breakfast Combo #1 which is the Egg McMuffin.  My drive to work is less then 5 minutes from the restaurant and my food was ice cold. The Canadian Bacon was tough and chewy. The best thing out of the combo was the cup of coffee. It was hot and strong.   The service was questionable. I wished them a Happy Egg McMuffin Day and neither the money taker or the one passing out the food at the next window, seemed to know what day it was. You'd think they would be the ones to be extending the celebratory greeting.   I'll give them another try, because I do like their Double Cheeseburgers on occasion, but my experience on Egg McMuffin Day is a solid #2. Yes, I meant the grade school humor in closing.   When: March 2, 2021 Why: National Egg McMuffin Day

Get out your crayons and color me surprised. This planting season, I searched high and low for plants, new pots and potting soil. After visiting many of my favorite nurseries, I ended up here at Menards and was shocked that they had some of the best offerings and definitely the lowest prices.   My new advice to shoppers who are searching for an hard to find item - Check out Menards, they just might surprise you. They colored me surprised.   Well I return? -Yep, I never know what I will find.   When: May 10, 2017  Why: Patio needed new plants.

I can finally mark it off my Bucket List. I attended a wedding at The Jewel Box.   A wedding at the JB is very compact and romantic. The beauty of the plants and the historic greenhouse adds to the ambiance.  The acoustics are surprisingly good, making it easy to hear the ceremony and the string quartet. At the beginning, it wasn't too warm in the box. However, as the ceremony progressed, I did start to feel the warmth of the greenhouse.   In my opinion, the true beauty at The Jewel Box is the grounds that surround the vintage greenhouse. The manmade ponds,  landscaping and sculptures are truly a beautiful sight. They are all maintained so well. It is why TJB is considered a true "jewel" of Forest Park.   The only downside of having a wedding at The Jewel Box is the time limitations. They keep you on a very tight schedule. They only unlock the doors shortly before the ceremony for guest and when the service is over, it is hustle and bustle to get out.

Free WI-FI and Special Menu for those who are 55+.   Worst service I have ever experienced, or should I say NO SERVICE. We arrived shortly after 10 AM. The only words we heard from the hostess was, "Follow me".  She walked us to our table, tossed the menu down and told us our server would be with us shortly. 15 minutes later, no one has approached our table. We couldn't even get the attention of those walking past us. We had enough, we got up and walked out.  This Denny's has been removed from my Breakfast list and added to my No-No list.    Free WI-FI is a nice offering, but it doesn't get them any more stars.

A name change and need for some old fashioned candy brought me back. For me I can say, it was a positive change. The sales lady was friendly and helpful. This time I did not walk out empty handed, I walked out with a bag busting at the seams. The goodies I found, completed a fantastic gift that I am sure will be the envy of our gift exchange.   Great selection, much better customer service. I am so glad I came back and even happier that I can raise the stars from 2 to 4. Congratulations, Itsy Bitsy, you no longer are on my Terrible Two's List.   Would I come back? When the need arises for old fashioned, what I grew-up calling "penny candy".   When: December 20, 2016 Why: Gift Stuffers

I've been here twice and my 3 star rating is the average of the two visits. My first visit was a solid 4 star experience. I visited during their opening week and our lunch was well worth the price. They kept the food fresh and the variety was extensive. As Travis stated, it was very bright and clean.  My second visit was Christmas day, we couldn't decide where or what to do that day and finally we just thought Chinese. We called and they were open till 7PM. We got there around 3PM and they were busy, busy. Being busy, was no excuse for lack of table service and dried out and poorly presented food. You'd think they'd be on an A- Game being a holiday, but they got only 2 Stars for Christmas.   Also, we saw no signage for the higher price for the holiday buffet. Normally a holiday buffet offers extra features, but this buffet looked no different then the lunch I experienced their opening week. I guess I shouldn't bitch to much about the higher price, they at least gave both of us the SENIOR discount. I do not look that old...lol.

Not my usual Lee's, but it was the most convenient while I was out running errands for me to pick up  our chicken dinner. The staff here was friendly and professional, just as those on Kingshighway. Also, as at any Lee's, the iced tea is kick ass good. It is equally as good as any you would be served in the deep south.   I favor the crispy chicken here at Lee's. It always has a good crunch and is juicy on the inside. One thing that Lee's offers as a chain, that separates itself from local chicken joints, is that they do not uncharge for requesting 3 thighs in the 3 piece dinner. That is quality customer service.   If this Lee's is in your hood and you're craving a fried chicken dinner, I would recommend you give them a try.

My most recent visit was just cocktails. We were meeting friends for custard at Andy's and finished shopping in Kirkwood early so we stopped by Bar Louie. It was a Sunday, so I enjoyed a Bloody Mary and my friend had a Mimosa. Lucky her, they had a promo going on for unlimited Mimosa's and she slammed a couple down before we crossed the street for custard.  Unfortunate for me, not such a deal. However, I did enjoy an amazing Bloody Mary made with Absolute Peppar.   Service was great and attentive. They kept the cocktails flowing.

Clean restaurant, friendly staff and fast service.  My roommate swears by the #9 which is the Italian Club with hot peppers. It's his favorite sandwich. Since I'm not a big fan of Jimmy, he takes advantage of enjoying this sammie when I'm working and he is off.   I haven't found a favorite, I've tried the #10 Hunters Club, #12 Beach Club and #13 Gourmet Veggie Club. Just like Subway, I find the bread to overwhelming. What also scares me about these sandwiches is the nutritional information. The sodium and carbohydrates are through the roof.   If I want a deli sandwich, I'd rather go to two other "local" deli's that are located in my hood.

I fell in love with this store while visiting the French Quarter. It's a great little boutique with NOLA themed silk ties, bow-ties, pocket squares and dog collars. They also had items for women and the home. It's all custom designed and manufactured locally in NO & LA. The designs are unique and creative. I'm from St. Louis so a Fleur de Lis has a special meaning to me, too.   I honestly had to make myself leave before I started to scoop up multiple items for myself and my dogs. I thought I was safe, until I got home and discovered they have a website that I can order from. Guess who's getting new collars and who's going to get new pocket squares?    I cannot wait to place my first order.   When: August 27, 2016 Why: I'm a Shopaholic

If you are in Kirkwood and craving a cupcake, Smallcakes can satisfy your craving. It wont WOW you, but you'll be satisfied.   I was surprised at the small variety that they had to offer and I was there during lunchtime. Lucky for me they had one of my favorites, Wedding Cake. An almond white cake with almond flavored buttercream frosting sprinkled with edible pearls. So my roommate wouldn't feel left out, I got him a Peanut Butter Cup, a chocolate cake with peanut butter cream cheese frosting and peanut butter cup crumbles on top.   Each of us found the frosting to be the best part of the cupcake. Both of our small cakes were on the dry side, they definitely needed to be more moist to compliment the amazing frosting.   The counter person was robotic, did not have the energy that I'd want and expect at a cupcake shop. Also beware of the parking lot it is crazy. Spots are a premium so be aware of those drivers around you. I had someone pulling in to my space before I had completely pulled out.

I have been on a mission to revisit all the businesses that I have given 2 Star ratings, in hopes that they can prove themselves worthy of an increase. Today I visited Oh Lolli Lolli and unfortunately they showed me that they actually deserve a 1 Star rating, but I couldn't bring myself to lower their rating. The ambiance and location saved them, but they are still a 2.   The young ladies working were unfriendly and when I asked questions their answers were short and curt. Once again I walked out empty handed. Later that day, I visited two other candy shoppes on my quest for a specific need and they both offered me exceptional customer service. Their excellent customer service resulted with me spending money in both stores. What a shame that the cash register did not ring at Oh Lolli Lolli - Itsy Bitsy Candy Shoppe.

And on a clear day... On that clear day... You can see forever... And ever... And ever... And ever more!  When you get to the top level of the Lewis and Clark Confluence Tower and burst in to song singing, On A Clear Day You Can See Forever, I can tell you, you will not be the first. All those tower guides have heard it before, it's not that original. However, I do think my rendition was note worthy.  I've been twice, I had to do a re-visit because on the first it was an overcast day.  It was amazing how far I could see when a few clouds were removed from blocking my view. Each time, our tour guide was knowledgeable about the history of the area and Lewis and Clark. Our first guide on the cloudy day was witty and put his own spin on the presentation of information. The second guide sounded like a rehearsed tour guide, but you still get the info you need.   It's a great outing for a family or a couple who just wants an adventure up the River Road.

I have to admit I have not eaten at a Denny's for at least 15 years and was surprised at what I experienced. It was a Sunday morning, we wanted a quick breakfast and a new experience.  One of us built a grand slam and the other an omelet. Both were presented very well and the omelet was huge and fluffy. The hash-browns were the best I've experienced in awhile, they had a crispy finish which I think makes hash browns. My partner loved his grits, the bowl was big enough to feed a family. Our waiter Louie was attentive and witty - I could so easy see him doing extremely well in another venue.  Denny's will not be a regular stop for me, but I will not wait another 15 years to re-visit.

Oh, Lolli Lolli you disappointed me so much. I heard and read such great Yelp things about you and was so excited to shop your little candy shoppe, that I made a special trip to the De Mun neighborhood.   When I arrived I thought the location was cute being next to a playground, giving you an endless flow of customers. I also enjoyed the compact size, you made use of every inch. Your staff was perky, friendly and was offered good customer service.   What disappointed me was your selection of sweet treats. There was nothing unique or special. I have a huge sweet tooth and I walked out empty handed.

Not impressed at all. Candy was boring and overpriced. I did not pay that much attention to the soda selection as I am not a big soda drinker.   I did find several humous signs that would be great joke gifts for various friends and family members.   Service was minimal, not even a greeting or  a thanks for coming in. With that type of customer service, I most likely will not be returning.

Poptions!, I am going to remove you from my Terrible Two's List, because you made one of my co-workers happy. She moved here from CA two years ago and loves Kettle Corn and has not found any that compared to the popcorn she loved back on the west coast. So after I shopped the plaza across the street, I popped in to see if you had some available. Lucky for her, you did and she loved it.   However, I will still say your customer service, sucks. I hope the distinguished curmudgeon who was working is not the owner. If he is, I highly recommend that he hire some friendly, upbeat employees and stay off the front line of his store. You're selling a fun product, a treat that everyone loves. Be happy when you're selling it, don't be a Donald Downer.  When: March 30, 2016 Why: Searching for Kettle Corn

Came back this morning and I can say it is still just a solid 3 Stars. It's nothing special, but it is a good affordable diner breakfast.   I'll start out by saying, they've changed their Bloody Mary mix and it was a nice improvement. Now they need to get rid of celery as a garnish. Another big plus for me, is a pot of hot fresh coffee being placed in front of me. When I need my cup of Joe filled, I can do it myself.   This morning, my breakfast of choice was, Chicken and Waffle. It came with a side of two eggs. I had mine scrambled. The chicken was a boneless breast. It had a thin crisp coating of seasoned breading. It wasn't that warm when served, but the flavor was good. The waffle was chewy, and tough to cut with a fork. It's hard to mess up scrambled eggs, so they were a okay.   Service at the bar was friendly, speedy and comfortable.   I'll be Back? - Most likely not. It's a drive for me and I pass too many other diners on the way.   When: July 11, 2018 Why: Wanted something new for breakfast.

Today was my first visit to Starrs. I have driven by numerous times and never gave it any thought. We had lunch Fozzie's  across the street and thought this would be a great opportunity to check it out.   Loved the beer selection, it was comprised of micro brews and craft beers. There was not one A-B, Miller's or Coors's product to be seen.   There selection of wine was wide and varied, but I have seen better prices. With New Year's Eve approaching, their selection of champagne was the best I've seen in a single store and the prices were reasonable.  Customer Service was good considering the fact they had two sales representatives for distributors in the store. They bounced back and forth between customers and the reps. They made sure our needs and questions were answered.   I'll be back they had one of my favorite micro beers that is hard to find and it's a secret ingredient in some of my recipes.

I love Costco!  It is not only a great place to stock up on staples, but you can find many other bargains for things that you just can't live without.   Their meat selection is better then some butcher shops. We always stock up on Rib-Eyes, Boneless Chicken Breast and Butterfly Pork Chops.  The  fresh vegetable and fruits look good, but being a couple the amount is too much.   Don't just think Best Buy or Ultimate Electronics for your HD TV, the prices here can put them to shame.   The clothes section is just like a TJ Maxx, it constantly changes and you have to shop and check it frequently. I have found Ralph Lauren several times and when I do, I buy one of every color.   You may need to buy a membership, but Costco is worth the investment.

Their prices are amazing. They are so competitive, you'd be a fool to  use one of the national chains, when you can support a local business.   I've had invitations for special occasions designed by a friend and then printed here and they blew me away with the end result. Each time, the quality, was top notch impressive. They've even printed banners for me.   The staff is aways professional and friendly. The Ink Spot is my go to, for printing and I recommend that it be the same for you, too.   I'll be back? - Absolutely   When: Numerous times.  Why: Custom Printing.

A small well maintained county park. Every little detail is well kept. The pavilions and picnic tables are in above average condition. Each pavilion has clean restrooms, one for each sex and a colorful jungle gym for the tiny tots to play near-by.   The roads circling the park were smooth and pot hole free and the laking lots for the pavilions looked better then some of the local malls. I was also impressed with how well maintained the landscaping was.   This truly is a great park for a romantic picnic. It is even great for a family reunion, company function and a small charity mixer.   I wish the city kept their parks, this well maintained and clean.   When: September 19, 2015 Why: A party for Shelties

It's true, it's true. Bigger is better. Reading my morning dose of Yelp  reviews, I saw that Jessica C. mentioned that they expanded, so I added TJ to my list of errands.   Upon entry I immediately impressed with the expanded produce and dairy section. A 3 lb. bag of Honey Crisp Apples for $3.99. At other grocer's they're $3.99 for 1 pound.  They may be smaller in size, but they still have the same big flavor of a Honey Crisp apple.   As always, all the other selections are unique, organic and exotic foods. Don't forget the wine and booze.......good bargains can always be found.   So glad this TJ finally got to expand. With the store having a claustrophobic feel when I shopped and the parking lot being a demolition derby, I always shied away. Now that it is bigger, all I have to worry about is the crazy parking lot.

I never knew this place existed until I was walking over to Washington Avenue from The Peabody Opera House. I'd seen the building, but always thought it was either a court house or part of the library. To my surprise it is a very well kept museum for our soldiers. I was amazed how well maintained the building and displays were kept. How have I lived in STL for 33 years and never visited our Soldiers Memorial.   Saint Louis has many well kept secrets and this is one of them. Don't let this hidden jewel remain a secret, visit it soon and tell those  history buffs you know that this is a must see on your next visit downtown.

It has been a year and Fields Foods is still a solid 4 for me. It is not my regular grocery store, for me it like a big convenience market. I am able to make a quick stop here after work and pick up last minute items for an evening meal.   I am happy to say, there has been an improvement in the fruits and vegetables since my last review. Caution is still used in my selection, but the quality is better then before.   The craft beer selection is vast for a grocery store of this size. Their variety of wines is also impressive and has a wide price point, to fit every budget.   Favorite departments are still the butcher counter and hot prepared foods. Shhhhh.....I have been know to grab some chicken wings from the hot bar and a six pack of craft beer for dinner.   Will I return? - Stop by at least once a week.   When: Numerous days Why: Odds and Ends in the grocery world.

Compassionate care at an affordable price.   There are no bells and whistles here. The waiting area and examining room are minimalist. That is why the prices are reasonable. You're not paying for prettiness. You truly are just paying for the medical care of your pet.   The vet techs and vets are truly caring for your pet. They ask questions and help you find the best care and treatment for your fur-babies within your budget. I was here with a friend and they truly helped him find the best solution for his dogs ailment. They even pointed out another issue and treated it as well.
