The only downside is they do not make appointments. It's like an urgent care, you show-up and wait in line for your turn. If you've got the time to wait, on a budget and need/want top care for your pet - this is the place for you.   Chances of returning? - Follow-up for Grace.  When: January 23, 2019 Why: Big Grace needed care

I use to favor the Rock Hill, Stein Mart. Now that I have discovered this one, my loyalties are changing. This location not only has a better selection of mens clothing, but the customer service here is also superior.   I am not afraid of color and I love the selection of colorful dress and sport shirts offered here. When shopping, the first racks I check out are those with the sign toppers offering an additional  percentage off the already lowest reduced price. On this last visit, I got three shirts for less then I would have gotten one at a local department store. Hell, the prices were even lower then the outlet mall.   The homewares department may be small, but it is amazing what you'll find. Again, on this last shopping expedition, I discovered Riedel wine glasses. I was in no need of glasses, but I bought a couple boxes to tuck away in a closet for future gifts.   I'll still stop by the Rock Hill store when I'm in that area, but this is my go to Stein Mart for now.   Will I return: Absolutely   When: December 20, 2017 Why: Shopping for me......

Great shoe store, especially for women. If a lady has an addiction to shoes, this is the place to shop for variety and price.   If it is so great, why am I giving them only 3 Stars? It is because of my feet. I have wide fat feet and DSW does not always have my width. If I had normal feet, I would definitely give them 5 Stars and I'd have a closet, just for shoes.   The selection for men is not as large as the ladies, but they still offer a good variety of; dress, casual, boots and athletic shoes. Some visits, I can walk out with a couple pairs, other times it is just one pair. The majority of my visits I walk out empty handed, due to my size.   I give major kudos to the staff, they are always helpful and willing to check warehouse inventory and to see if the shoe I like comes in a wide.   Like #41, George H. W. Bush, I enjoy a colorful sock and DSW has an excellent selection to choose from.   I'll be back? - I keep checking for my size.   When: December 3, 2018 Why: Brown Casual Shoe

It's a drug store. A chain drug store and it meet my needs.   I was at the dentist awhile back and they took my blood pressure before they started work on my implants. I was a BP monitor style that I had not seen before and it was a CVS brand. Instead of a regular cuff that I'd have to put around my arm, this one slipped over the wrist. So easy.   My regular doctor wants me to check my BP on the regular, so I came here to buy one. It was an easy find in the store and a great value when compared to the Omron brand also available in the store.   Store was well organized and the staff was able to answer my questions about my investment in a new BP monitor.   I'll be back? - I own stock in Walgreen's, but I just may be back to this                         store. They did a good job.

Need new kitchen knives, shop Bertarelli.  Need your current kitchen knives sharpened, take them to Bertarelli.   Need some new gadget for the kitchen, shop Bertarelli. My favorite gadget was battery powered pepper mill. It was so cool.  Customer Service is great.

Whisker Bones is a fun doggie boutique on Main Street, just down from one of my favorite E-ville restaurants. They offer a variety of services. They not only make all natural & organic treats, they also offer pet photography, grooming and unique pet accessories.   Oh, did I mention the large selection of decorative home accessories? In addition to the countless magnets for your car or whatever.  When I shop, I get frustrated when I see things for dog mom's and nothing for us dad's. Not here, since this doggie boutique is owned by two dog dad's, there was plenty of dad stuff for me to choose from. I'm also obsessed with the color orange and I found the cutest paw print bowl.   The staff is friendly and helpful. Even though I live on the Westside of the river, I signed up for their rewards program. I come over frequently enough to eat at some of my favorite restaurants. Now that I have discovered WBS, I'm be stopping by every time I come to E-ville to dine.   Will I return - You know it.   When: August 31, 2017 Why: I'm a sucker for a doggie boutique

I don't get the love for this place at all. I have tried this place numerous times with friends and each time we all walk out scratching our heads. The service is minimal at best. Our most recent visit, we were the only ones sitting at the upstairs bar and we still had a hard time getting waited on. The young lady working that bar treated us as if we were an inconvenience and an interruption to her night.  We drank half of our cocktails, which were made very amateurish and left.   There are too many other bars in Saint Louis where you can get a professional and masterfully made cocktail, so I suggest you take a pass on Planter's House.
This review is going to be short and direct.  Popcorn - Stale. (They should be embarrassed)  Customer Service - Poor & Unfriendly.  Flavors - Unique. (Saved them from getting a lone star rating)

I'm giving Jet's 4 Stars for the simple reason that they sell their pizza by the slice. There are so many times that I crave pizza, but go without because I do not want to order an entire pizza pie. Now I can stop by Jet's, enjoy a single or two slices of pizza and be satisfied. I can grab it and go home, or sit down at one of the several tables available in their small dining room.   I've also ordered an entire pizza for pick up. I live so close it is quicker to pick up then to have one delivered. I like having the option of adding flavor to the crust, it gives it a extra kick of flavor. Their sauce has a sweet tang, they are generous with the toppings and cheese. Being  a chain, provel is not the primary cheese.   The staff is friendly and the facility is super clean. It's a chain, but it is still a nice addition to my hood.

OMG! I have to admit, I had no idea they offered 5 different crust. Seriously, I thought all they had was Deep Dish. Recently I was waiting for my order and as I read the posters and discovered they had five different crust.   Being a fan of STL Thin Crust, I was excited to see that was one of their offerings. My favorite toppings are Italian Sausage or Pepperoni with Jalapeños. Actually, put jalapeños on any pizza and I'll be a happy diner. I also enjoy the flavor of their sauce, for me it has a rich, robust Italian flavor.    I've ordered on-line and have stopped by for a quick pick-up when I've been out and about. Either way, the service has always been quick and friendly. Compared to the other chain pizzerias in my hood, Jet's takes the Blue Ribbon for both flavor and service.   I'll be back? -Definitely, I love a good thin crust pizza.   When: February 24, 2018 Why: Discovered they have thin crust.

I've been twice and both times I have been pleased with my experience. My first visit, I enjoyed a Pretzel Wrapped Meat made with Cajun Chicken. It had just enough spice and kick. Paired with a large drink, it made a satisfying lunch.   My visit today, I just wanted a snack to hold me over till dinner. I was torn between an order of Nuggets or Two Softies. After looking at the size of the softies and the lowest number of nuggets in an order, I went with the two softies. Being a lover of jalapeños, I had to select the jalapeño cheese sauce for dipping.   It's a very clean operation. As you order at the counter, you have a full view of the kitchen, where they make their tasty pretzels. The staff is young and friendly.   I'll be back? - Next time I'm craving a soft pretzel, this is where I'll go.   When: April 18, 2019 Why: No lunch, needed a snack before dinner.

Lily's is a cross between the authentic Mexican restaurants down on Cherokee and a Qudoba. What? I know it is a weird combination, so let me explain. The food is good and authentic reminding me of Cherokee street, but the service is order at a counter  go sit down and that reminds me Qudoba.  We had top shelf Margarita's which are made from scratch and Poppa is proud of his creation. Our dinner was a Lily's Special, Chile Relleno, Chicken Enchilada and a Beef Tamale. I enjoyed all three, you could tell they were hand made with love. We also had appetizers, Queso and Guacamole. Their guacamole is the best I have had in the city, even better then some I've had down on Cherokee.   When your food is ready, the girls or momma bring it to your table and are chatty when making the delivery.  My question is, if you bring the food out why not take the order at the table as well.  I think providing complete table service would add to Lily's experience and may even get an increase in stars and patronage.

Lowe's selection of table lamps and shades, is pretty amazing for a hardware store. I was searching for some Neo-Classic style lamps and found two here that meet my needs. Not only did they meet my decorating needs, but they came in well beneath my budget requirements.   They sell their lamps and shades separately, so you can totally create the look that is your personality. All you have to do is make sure they have the same code letter.  Its kind of like matching up your Garanimals for a cute children's outfit. "M" shades go with a "M" lamp base and the same for "S" and "L".    Take note of Lowe's full name, it is Lowe's Home Improvement Warehouse. So it is not just a hardware store. You can find many decorative things to make your home, your castle. I have found great window treatments at better prices then BB&B (without a coupon) and patio furnishings.   It may be a chain and a warehouse store, but the selection and prices keep me coming back.

When: March 8 Why: Shipping a package  I've used the UPS office for years and have never been disappointed.  The location is great. It is on Jefferson between 64 & 44 making it easy to get in and out.   The customer service has always been friendly and helpful. Even when I have seen a long line they move it quickly and still provide a top notch attitude.

This location has become my go to Bed Bath & Beyond, since the one in Brentwood relocated. The newer BB&B on Eager Road, just doesn't do it for me any more.    This store is where I go for kitchen gizmos and bed linens. I can always find some new gadget or small appliance that I cannot live without in my kitchen. They also stock bed linens that have fully elasticized fitted sheets with excellent thread counts.   The staff here is also more helpful and personable then those at my old favorite location. What's also better about this location, is it is closer to my home.   I'll be back? - When a gadget or gizmo calls my name.   When: April 18, 2019 Why: Coffee Pod Filters and new pizza pan

Impressive!   I was totally blown away as I walked through this store. With every corner I turned, my jaw dropped. The variety of china and crystal was amazing. If you have inherited family heirloom china and are missing a piece or two, this is the place to come. If they do not have it here in St. Louis, they may have it in their store in St. Petersburg, Florida. If not, they still are the ones who will be able to help you locate those missing pieces.   Personally I have inherited three sets of china, one set is soon to be 80+ years old and several sets of crystal. So I am thrilled to find this store in my hometown.

The "Computer Eye" at Sherwin - Williams saved our ass. We are doing some major landscaping and when we had bushes removed the foundation behind them needed to be painted to match the rest of the foundation. I painted the foundation, years ago and worried how are we going to match something that was done six years ago.   Luckily, we had one area that was starting to chip and we pulled off a swatch and took it to Sherwin - Williams. We shared our story and they said, "no problem". They took our swatch and their computer matched it perfectly.  Very knowledgeable staff, they made our painting project easier then we thought it would be. Thanks SWC for a job well done.

It's been almost 8 years since I posted my first review for this USPS and my opinion hasn't changed. I'll admit, I may be a little biased since it is at the beginning of my street.   When you live this close to a PO, it does make life easier. It is so easy to buy unique stamps, ship packages and mail those thank-you notes your mother taught you to write. If I walk out my front door and see a full parking lot, I go back inside my house and wait until the lot is emptier. Yes, that is one of the perks of living close. I watch the lot and I never have to wait.   The staff here on average is fairly friendly. Like most postal workers and DVM workers, they don't move real fast, but they do complete their task efficiently.

Not my normal BBB, but I was in the neighborhood so I thought why not save time and shop here instead of driving to the one in Richmond Heights. This location seems to be older and not as well kept as my usual BBB. However, considering the time of year, I am going to say it is the holiday craziness that made this store seem cluttered.   My hand mixer died and not wanting to  pull out the full size mixer every time I needed to do a small amount of whipping, I grabbed my BBB 20% off coupon and went shopping. I wanted an orange one to match my other small electric appliances, but no such luck. I did find a nice steel grey one with 2 sets of utility attachments and a storage bin.   If you need kitchen gadgets or small electronics grab your BBB coupon and go shopping. I do not recommend shopping at BBB without a coupon, because some of their regular prices can be on the high side.

This is truly an architecturally vintage post office located in the heart of Maplewood. The history and the architectural design of the building, is actually the  best thing about it.   This post office is a convenient location to buy stamps and get a quick money order when you need one. However, they are very similar to your local Wal-Mart store. That means, they will only have one window open for customer service. So, be prepared to wait.   When: September 29, 2021 Why: Friend needed money order

F&B Eatery is a quaint little sandwich shoppe serving both hot and cold sandwiches. The burgers are hand pressed and grilled to your liking, my medium temperature is always done right. They also, hand cut their house fries regular or sweet potato, which is a nice touch. Being small, they put a lot of details and preparation into their sammies. The garnishes; lettuce, tomato and onion are available upon request.   Their soda offerings are local - they have Excel available on the fountain and the have bottled Ski in a cooler.  The staff is friendly and as you become a regular diner, they'll remember your name. F&B Eatery is a good addition to my neighborhood. I'm looking forward to going back and enjoying a Rueben on my next visit.  When: February 17, 2016 Why: Lunch

A local, privately owned and operated business that provides quality work at a reasonable price. This a true Saint Louis mom & pop business. Because most times it is a Viviano helping you in the store or installing  the products at your home.   They have installed doors and windows at my house and most likely will be doing an awning or two later this summer.  I have shopped around and their prices are very competitive. Proving the "big box" is not always the best deal.  The customer service is personable and they are based in my hood.   When I need doors, windows or awnings, it is Viviano's for me.  I hope you'll do the same.

Fuddruckers is a weird burger joint. They make their own buns, which sets them apart from other specialty burger restaurants. However, I want the beef to impress me, not the bun. For me it just wasn't a good piece of meat. The works bar, where you dress your own burger, freaked me out too.   The french fries are wedge aka Steak Fries. They are seasoned well, but my order could have been done a little crisper. They were soft on the outside and the inside wasn't that hot. My friend had onion rings as his side and you could tell they were fresh and done in house. A shame they lacked flavor and the portion was skimpy.   Highlight was the fancy high tech coke machine. I got a real charge out of pushing all the buttons for my perfect ice chilled beverage.   My friend and I differed on the rating, I say 2 he said 4. So I went with the average, 3 Stars.  Next time I am in this hood and crave a burger, I will be stopping at Five Guys down the street.

Not as impressed as everyone else. Yes, it has a fabulous retail space and the merchandising and selection of the plants is great. What the down side is, most of their plants are overpriced and not all employees are as knowledgeable as you'd hope. In fact, some of them are down right aloof.  Keep talking to the various people working, you'll find one who knows the answer.   When shopping here, be sure to know the market price, especially if you are doing a large project. We did find a couple very unique plants for our front retaining wall and paid the inflated price. However, all the other plants we were considering we found at other city nurseries at a noticeably lower price. When you are buying in volume, it does add up quickly.  I will still continue to shop the nursery here, it just will not be my go to one.   I look forward to returning to experience the restaurant.

5 stars for a Post Office! You may be shocked, but this PO deserves every one of these five stars.   When I moved into my neighborhood 8 years ago, I had no idea how convenient would be to have a PO down the street. When friends found out where I moved, several commented I had moved near the best kept secret PO in the city. It is tucked away on a side street, making it convenient and away from busy traffic. Your able to get in and out with no problems.   I've never known them to be out of shipping supplies and they always seem to have the unique stamps that I prefer to use.   Best of all, they workers here are genuinely happy. When a worker is happy, they provide good customer service. I have seen lines here, but this crew knows how to keep the flow flowing.   Shhhhhh. Remember this is a well kept secret how good this PO truly is. Let's just keep it between us Yelpers.

Yippie! It's been a long time since we've had a new baby in our family and we finally have one on the way.   Since those little people grow so fast, they are in and out of sizes so quickly. I was shopping with a friend and while they looked for clothes in the adult section, I strolled through the baby section.   I was impressed with the variety and more so with the price point. This new addition to our family is going to grow so fast, why spend a fortune on outfits, when you can make him look cute at bargain prices.   I really not an Uncle, but I have had that title bestowed upon me. So as this little guy grows up, I'll be shopping here periodically to add to his closet and drawers.   I don't recall seeing any associates on the sales floor, but I am fairly self sufficient when I shop. The cashier when checking out was fast and efficient.   When: September 1, 2021 Why: Baby Clothes

One of my favorite spots in STL for a burger. If size is important to you you'll love a Seamus burger.  Their flame broiled burgers are HUGE and are full of flavor. A flame broiled burger, just seems to be juicier. They offer crinkle cut fries as side and they always give me more then I can eat and I love fries. The fries are done crispy, but I am fairly certain they are from a bag.   Our last visit we discovered their Club Sandwich and Chicken Wings are also worthy of a good shout out. I love experiencing new items off their menu, but it is their burger that will always have my heart.

A very good Irish Pub in the heart of Dogtown.  The burgers here are off the charts - they are some of the best in the entire city. They are grilled over open flame pit and the flavor is amazing. They also have a Rib Eye Steak Sandwich that is shockingly better then the burgers. The french fries are done to perfection as a side. If two of you are getting burgers, one of you needs to get the onion rings so you can share the two sides. Yes, the portions are large enough to share. Want to eat healthy? The Chef Salad is as the menu says, "a meal within itself". Beer is ice cold and the servers make for a pleasant dining experience.

If you love vintage, you're going to love shopping at Strangelovely. I am so glad Kim relocated her fabulous shop from Chicago back to her hometown roots. It fits perfectly inside this historical home.   Her boutique has not only fashions, but decor for the home. I missed out on two fabulous nude male sketches for my new bathroom. They were snatched up by another shopper and we had a good laugh. He was buying them for the exact same reason.  One table displaying a large variety of serving pieces really caught my eye. It had something for everyones taste. It was a good mix, of silver-plate and brass. With these pieces, a novice could create a stunning table for entertaining.   I only made a small purchase, but it was a favorite item. I added two soy candles to my collection in masculine scents, Tobacco and Black Pepper. I can't wait to strike a match and have the aroma fill my new house.   Kim and her associates were charming and helpful. I'm looking forward to shopping again, since it is less than a mile from my home.   When: February 6, 2021 Why: Shopping Local

A group of ten meet here around 9pm after doing three hours of volunteering. We were eager to reward ourselves with cocktails and food. Once we all arrived we were meet with disappointment, the kitchen was closed. It appears they put a new floor in the kitchen and it had to be closed ALL DAY. Oh well, our server kept the drinks flowing.  You'd think a business owner would have paid the extra $'s to put the floor in after the kitchen closed the previous night so it would be ready for the next days business. I'm confident the money made for an open kitchen would have paid for the extra expense, instead of losing an entire day of  food sales. Just think, if they served us food they might have had a fourth star and if the food was good a fifth.

It was time for a work birthday party and we discussing cake. One of my co-workers, said how about trying, "The Cakery". I immediately light up and said, YES! YES! I grabbed my smartphone, and showed them reviews and pictures on Yelp to sell them on the idea of ordering the cake from, The Cakery.   My enthusiasm sold them and we ordered the birthday cake. The honoree is a big candy lover, so we selected one topped in a variety of sweet treats. The cake was a two tiered chocolate separated by a vanilla butter creme. The top was close to a Tiffany Blue dripping down the sides. Beautiful presentation.   Our birthday boy loved his cake and my co-workers who had never experienced, The Cakery were totally impressed. They loved the rich flavor and how moist the cake was. This was a total win.   Perhaps we'll celebrate the next birthday with cupcakes from, The Cup. I already started singing the praises of their cupcake store.   Would I go again? Yes, I always love a good cake.   When: October 7, 2017 Why: Birthday Celebration

What an amazing "Little Shop".  It is, Estate Sale goes boutique.  They've got some unique art work, delicate china and crystal and antique/vintage furniture. The items for sale would be considered to be "best" of the best. It may be the best, but the prices are still affordable and 100% of the proceeds go to the Missouri Botanical Gardens. Resulting in guilt free shopping, because you actually are donating to a charity.

United Provisions is another great addition to The Loop. This store is an excellent blend of a Whole Foods type grocery store, with a mix of an ethnic market and a breathtaking selection of craft beers.   It's not close enough for me to do regular shopping, but I can't resist popping in after a lunch or dinner at Mission Taco Joint.   I'll be honest, the single bottle sales of craft beers and the ability to create a six pack has helped me create some cool gifts for various family members. This service alone makes me a fan.   If you're in The Loop, shop United Provisions, you'll surprise yourself with what you can find.

I love this theater, I like the stadium seating. I am a short person and enjoy the fact that I do not need to worry about a member of the Harlem Globetrotters sitting in front of me. However, it does amaze me how all the attendees do seem to congregate in the same area of the theater. We were the first to arrive and as the other viewers arrived, we chuckled how they clustered around around our seats.   There is a Walgreen's adjacent to this AMC and if you shop before your movie, you'll see a display of theater candies on sale. Their signage actually says, "theater candy", 3 for $3. They are truly taking advantage of their location.  Being winter we had deep pockets for stocking up on treats and bottled beverages that were on sale for only a $1 as well.   The theaters are always clean, as are the restrooms and as I stated in my previous review the staff is friendly.  Only thing that is a negative, it the volume is always louder then I think they need to be.

I love this store. I don't shop here that often, but when I do, I always find what I am looking for. It has an amazing men's department and the shoe department will blow your mind for both men and women.   I am sure you've all heard about the customer service at Nordstrom and it is true. Every time I have shopped here, the service has always been attentive and beyond what you receive at any other local department store. As we see the business at major department stores dwindling away, Nordstrom is still bringing their A-Game with merchandise and customer service.   I'll be back? - Hell, yes.   When: June 13, 2018 Why: Wedding clothes.

I love that a local business, Carol House Furniture  also gives back to our community by helping control the pet population of Saint Louis. Brook and Amy are both big homeless pet advocates and for me it speaks volumes that they walk the talk by providing this clinic to the Saint Louis area.   Having your pet spayed or neutered not only helps control unwanted litters, but it also improves the health of your dog or cat.  Many of us pet owners know, having your pet fixed can be a costly procedure. Here at CHQFPX, you can do it at a very reasonable price. Dogs are only $59 and cats can be fixed for only $39. The month of February 2013 they are having a cat special for only $20.   On Saturday, between 12-2 you can also get various shots for your pets at a fraction of the cost as well.   Let's  not have any unwanted litters and increase the number of pets in our local animal shelters. Take this opportunity and have your pet spayed or neutered  here.

West County is so lucky. The Fresh Market selected them as their first location in the Saint Louis market. I went their opening day and was totally impressed with the merchandising, freshness and customer service. If they open other locations in the Saint Louis market, they will be setting a new standard for groceries.   The Fresh Market is a grocery store that has a boutique type style. Best way to describe it would be that it is a cross between Whole Foods and Trader Joe's. Lot's of organic products, grass feed beef, gourmet baked goods and unique brands you may not have heard of before. The pricing is high end like Whole Foods. I wish it were more like TJ's.   If they keep up the standards of opening day, this new grocer is going to be a smashing success. The only negative I experienced was the parking. The lot truly was a parking lot derby.

All Steak 'n Shakes are not  the same, when it comes to serving breakfast. The one near my home in STL serves up a fantastic breakfast, but this one was just sad.  I would of been better off going to the IHOP down the street and paying full price instead of trying to save money with a coupon.   Let me start by giving the positives which really make this a 2.5 Stars (Yelp needs to give us the power of the half) review.  My waitress was friendly and hustling being the only server working. My Hash-Browns was crispy and a large serving. They also got my eggs done right, I like over medium and most places either over or under fry them.    Negatives;  only got a half cup of coffee to start out, had to wait for fresh to be made.  My refill was hot & fresh, but I was done eating and only enjoyed two sips. Even though my eggs were cooked correctly, they were greasy. The biscuit, was hard, dried our and almost flat as a pancake.   I will revisit this location for a steak-burger, but it is out of my breakfast rotation.

Coffee and an Orange Scone (my favorite) before a movie inside the mall.   Service was iffy, not as attentive and friendly as other St Louis Bread locations. They kept running out of coffee, I only got a half cup when filling up first time and then when I went back for a re-fill all dispensers except the flavored were empty. Having worked in the coffee biz, there is no excuse for empty coffee crafts.  Great location in the parking lot of an upscale mall. Allows you to shop high-end and eat within your budget.

We needed lunch at work and no one wanted to go out into the nasty weather. So I thought of Park Chop Suey, knowing that they delivered.   Our food was surprisingly good and delivered fast. I will say, the Crab Rangoon was the best fast Chinese I have ever had. They were huge, and you get six instead of the usual four from other restaurants. Their egg rolls were small, but full of flavor. Our main entrees were Special and Beef Fried Rice.  I always worry that  Fried Rice will be dry, not here it was moist which made it's flavor pop.   Next time we need lunch delivered, we're calling Park Chop Suey again.

I stopped in Acero for a cocktail and nosh before meeting friends a few doors down on Manchester. I sat at the bar, enjoyed an amazing Manhattan and for my nosh I had, Gnocco Fritto~"Meat Donut" Prosciutto di Parma, Sea Salt and Olive Oil. OMG!  I am not a Manhattan type guy, I am more of a Martini man. I do not know what possessed me order the Manhattan, I blame it on the ambiance. Acero just has a whiskey type feel. My drink was smooth, refreshing and of course I had it up like my martini's.   Now let's talk "Meat Donut". A strange donut does not get much better then this one.  A fluffy, flakey puff pastry shell wrapped in Prosciutto, seasoned with the perfect dash of sea salt and drizzled with olive oil. They were the perfect appetizer to accompany my Manhattan.   I saw a serving of their Sea Scallops pass me by at the bar and I know I will be back to enjoy them as well. Of course, I will be enjoying another order of these amazing "meat donuts".

A great little coffee shop with no bells and whistles. There are no frills here, just good coffee. Good coffee that is made with the same smoke and mirrors that a magician uses in Las Vegas.  After your first sip you'll be saying, "wow how did he do that".   No frills means, no muffins or pastries of any kind. You come here for some serious "Joe". Why would you want to distract from the true star of the show, with  a cheese danish or Poppy Seed Muffin.   Those who think anal retentiveness is a bad thing have not been to Sump and had a coffee drink made by Scott. His preciseness in making your latte, cappuccino or espresso will have you smirking the next time you pass a Starbucks.

Big fan of the Bug Store on Shaw, so yesterday after having lunch in Kirkwood I checked this location out and was equally impressed. If you have a friend or family member who is big in to gardening, this is the place to shop for their next gift. If you yourself are a big gardener, this place will provide you with items to bedazzle your yard.   The variety of birdhouses, decorative yard figures, patio furniture, wall hangings and yard flags were all unique. I was impressed with the variety of Cardinal stuff they had to show your support for our Boys of Summer.   The statuesque lady working was charming and helpful. She was very skilled at servicing the multiple shoppers all at once and knew her inventory well. When a customer described an item, she knew exactly where it was and quickly hustled to retrieve it.  I was also very fond of her assistant, Buddy. A very distinguished mix breed, who served as greeter and I believe security.   I will be loyal to the Bug Store on Shaw, but I will now make it a point visit this location whenever I am in Kirkwood.

We use to be loyal fans of Panda, but recently strayed to another Chinese Restaurant on Chippewa. Last night we were craving Moo Shu and thought it was time to go back to Panda Pavilion.   In addition to our Moo Shu Pork, we ordered a Chicken St. Paul, Egg Rolls, Crab Rangoon and Plain Fried Rice. I am happy to say, the Moo Shu Pork, Fried Rice were very good. The Crab Rangoon were huge and had plenty of filling. However, the Egg Rolls and St. Paul tasted as if they were fried in old oil.  They were extremely busy, so I highly recommend calling your order in ahead of arriving. This evening I did not call ahead, but they still got my prepared quickly.

I am not a regular mall shopper, so when I arrived at the Galleria to buy chocolates for my hairstylist I was surprised Bisssingers had left the building. I had a hair appointment across the street, so I needed something to go with the bottle of wine as her holiday gift. I quickly regrouped and headed over to Godiva and they saved the day.   The manager was very helpful in showing me different gift boxes that were on sale and another table that had mix and match items that would be great stocking stuffers. What made her customer service extra special is that she came out from behind that huge counter displaying all the sinful delights and joined us in the sales area. She was very personable and persuasive.   I left with not only a gift for my hair stylist, but a few extra gifts to have on hand just in case. I also signed up for their rewards program. By being a member I get a free non liquor truffle every month for just stopping by, no purchase necessary. That may be motive enough to get me into the mall more often.
I live in the city, and when I go to a movie this is my choice when I want a big screen. The staff is friendly, it is clean and who doesn't like stadium seating.

Great place to recycle your florescent bulbs. I took in  several 4 ft bulbs and they charged me .48¢ each as a service fee. I will gladly pay that minimal fee to save our environment.   I also did not walk out empty handed, I was in need of a couple flashlights for when the power goes out and found some in my favorite color orange. If it is orange and something I can use, I will normally buy it. I need a support group for those attached to the color orange.   Great customer service, they make shopping for bulbs and batteries and enjoyable experience.

Yes, I am a fan of Treats Unleashed. You want to know why? Because, no matter what store I shop, I know I am going to get high quality freshly made in house treats for my fur-baby. In addition to the treats, I will receive top notch personalized service. The associates are always friendly, knowledgeable and make me feel like my dog is the best in the world.   TU is also a great place to buy quality dog food. This is when the staff really shine. They are so knowledgeable in the nutritional facts about the various brands. My baby eats totally grain free dry food and he's healthy as can be.   If you're in need of accessories for your four legged friend, you can find beds, toys and colorful collars and leashes.   If you love your K-9, you need to shop here. They're the best.

Jack, you know how to make a good cheeseburger.  I love the Ultimate Cheeseburger, in my opinion it is most likely the best fast food cheeseburger available. When it comes to my cheeseburgers I am a purist. I do not want anything else on the burger distracting me from the main attraction, "cheese". You can keep your fresh lettuce, tomato and rings of onion to yourself, I don't need them I have cheese.   The Ultimate is made for people like me. It is two beef patties, American, Swiss and Cheddar Cheese with a mayo-onion sauce, mustard and ketchup on a sesame seed bun. What more do you need? That is a perfect cheeseburger.   When I visit JITB, all I get is my Ultimate and a coke. I guess this is my Cheeseburger Cheeseburger.   Smile and say "Cheese".

As I sat down in front of my computer to create a new Yelp List for Fried Pickles, I realized I have not updated my "The Mack" review to highlight their Fried Pickles.  How could this be, one of the first places I experienced the decadent appetizer and I did not mention in a review. Proof that it is important to keep your Yelp reviews up to date with your experiences.   The Fried Pickles at The Mack are crinkle cut dill chips covered in a thick crisp batter and served with a Southwest type Ranch dipping sauce. The SW Ranch gave an  extra kick, to an already tasty pickle. As Jennifer T. suggested, keep some of the dipping sauce for your fries as well.   The Mack already is on my list for burgers and chicken wings and now it is on my new Fried Pickles list.

Love this Lion's Choice, the Roast Beef is always tender and full of flavor. The beef always has a little pink to it, so you know it hasn't been over cooked like some other fast Roast Beef restaurants.  I agree with Chrissie, ask for extra seasoning on your sandwich. Another flavor booster I recommend is mixing Lion Choices BBQ Sauce with the ketchup for dipping your french fries.

Whenever I'm shopping at Carniceria Latino Americana, I fantasize that I'm in a little grocery store in Cuernavaca. I roam up and down the aisles visiting every nook and cranny.  Many of the labels test my high school Spanish to the limits. However, I usually can figure it out by the labels. They're pretty much the same, just a different language.   The staff is friendly and helpful. There are no language barriers here, just good customer service. So when preparing your own versions of Mexican Cuisine at home I highly recommend shopping here for your supplies.   The only downside to shopping here is when you exit.  You'll  realize you are still in Saint Louis and have only been shopping on Cherokee street.

Another good experience at Filomena's.  What impresses me most about this family business, it they are consistent in their customer service and food quality. Every time I have dined here, I have been totally satisfied with my meal.   My most recent visit was our International Supper Club meeting of 14 hungry Yelpers.  I was excited when I saw they had added a Tutto Mare with Penne Pasta to their menu. It was a rich tomato, butter sauce with shrimp, scallops and mushrooms. The portion was large enough for me to take half of it home for dinner the next night.   I also enjoyed a small house salad which is Romaine lettuce with mozzarella and provolone cheeses, artichoke hearts, red onion and tomato served with their house balsamic vinaigrette. Dressing is damn good.   14 of us ordered separately and they still managed to time all of our food to come out in a timely fashion. Specializing in carryout, they were very cordial and accommodating to our large group of diners. When ever I'm  in Glendale around mealtime, I'll always think of Filomena's.

We had a coupon and thought we'd try a new Chinese takeout. It was lunch time so we ordered two lunch specials, and were pleased with both. The egg roll was excellent, and the Crab Rangoon's were some of the best carry-out I've experienced. The pork fried rice as a side was also very good. Out of the two entrees we ordered, the Orange Chicken was the best.  For lunch portions I thought they were very large.  Very close to house so it is easy to pick-up, but delivery would be nice.

The only thing that could improve Culver's is table service and ice cold beer. The Double Deluxe Hamburger with crinkle fries is a great treat after some power shopping at Costco. On second thought, who needs beer when you can have a Culver's Root Beer. Once you've tasted it, you'll wish it was available in a six pack to take home. Always share an order of onion rings, it just makes the meal complete.

Had the Greek Salad with gyro meat, the meat was very tender and flavorful. The plate was extremely small for the portion of salad. Whenever you forked a bite, lettuce and meat would slide off the plate. Would it be asking to much for a large plate? Let's be serious, you're not fooling anyone if you are trying to make the portions look larger.  Our waiter was extremely friendly and made our dinning experience enjoyable.  We'll be going back.

I get a chuckle that J & A's is a smoking bar, except between the hours of 10 AM - 2 PM. Why you ask? It is so all the employees from local businesses can come in and enjoy their amazingly good burger and fries. It may be a four hour reprieve from smoking, but the place still reeks of smoke and grease. It is an aroma that lets you know it is a true dive bar.   The staff is always friendly and if you sit at the bar, the regulars make you feel like you are one of them. However, I prefer to sit at one of the tables opposite the bar and people watch. As I've said in other dive bar reviews, the clientele is right out of a reality show.   Cheap drinks, good eats and fun customers is why this dive bar  is the oldest bar in the Lou.

WOW! I had no idea how cool this place was. I was in the area for a lunch with friends at another restaurant, and saw signs providing directions to O'Fallon Brewery. So, after an amazing BBQ lunch, I stopped by O'Fallon for a quick beer.   When I arrived, I honestly was just expecting a brewery offering cold brews and nothing more. To my surprise, they are a fun blown restaurant. I was in awe watching all the plates going by and then I'd read the menu to match it up. I'm coming back and enjoying some wings or a flatbread for sure.   Any way, on this visit all I had was a Vanilla Pumpkin beer. At any given time, there are 20 O'Fallon Craft Beers on tap. Back to the Vanilla Pumpkin, it was refreshing and may be my new Octoberfest beer.   Bartender was attentive and professional. He didn't mind that I wasn't eating and that I only stopped in for a beer.   I'll be back? - Yes, now that I know that they're a restaurant, too.   When? - October 3, 2018 Why? - Signs directed me to the brewery

Pure Plates is an easy and affordable way to pack and plan your lunches for work. I would easily spend between $7 and $10 for lunch if I went out, so I do not mind paying that for a healthy and well portioned meal.   Each prepared meal comes packaged in a recyclable container with a nutritional label giving you all the information you want to know. Each meal only needs to be heated up for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, which is a lot faster then any fast food joint. It's healthier, too.   My two favorites so far are: Spaghetti Squash with Turkey and Pecan Crusted Chicken. I can't wait to explore more of their wide varieties of prepared meals.   Will I return? - Yes, makes my work lunches easier.   When: May 10, 2017 and other dates Why: Too lazy to cook work lunches.

Once you get past the "Diva Hostess" who thinks she is superior to those she is seating, who'll have a pizza that will have you saying, "wow, this is what a pizza should be". We had the chicken wings as an appetizer and were pleased with the flavor, you can taste the chili seasoning. Our pizza was the CWE, thin crust and was fantastic. I can't wait to go back and expand my experience by trying a deep dish. Our waiter, was a delightful & charming, he made up for the "heroin chic" hostess. He knew she was an issue and downer.

This Starbucks is still just a solid 3 Stars. They get the job done, but without any extra pizzaz in customer service.   I stopped in to pick up a Grande Cold Brew before my class over at the Apple store. The cashier was very dry, to be honest I do not remember her even thanking me or ordering. The wait for my beverage was minimal, considering two others were ahead of me in line. The young lady who presented me my drink, did thank me for coming in. So I figured, it was her job to say, "thanks".   I wish Starbucks would go to paper straws or the new lids that are like a travel mug and do away with the plastic straws.   Will I return? - Only if I am taking a class at the Apple store.   When: February 27, 2020 Why: Liquid refreshment for class

It was time for new work shoes and the last pair I bought at Laurie's were winners so I went back for the exact same shoe. At work we have a dress code, so not much fun in buying shoes. They have to be black,  a no skid sole and they have to tie, no slip on. I know it's yawn city, but Laurie's helped me find a pair that does not lead to depression when I put them on.   At least while I was there, I made note of a new pair of tennis shoes and loafers to make my feet truly happy.   I've said it before and will say it again, when you are in the market for shoes you've got to check Laurie's Shoes out.

It's a dive bar.   You'll have a good time drinking well prepared drinks at an amazingly affordable price.   The ambiance is bland, but remember it is a dive bar, so that actually adds to its beauty.   There is no bar food. Your snacks and munchies come out of a vending machine that is also reasonably priced.   They have hooks and outlets under the bar. Nice asset for a dive bar.   Bartenders are friendly, attentive and mix a good cocktail. They can even open a bottle or can of beer with finesse.   I recommend that you grab some friends and head over to SC for a fun time. Or, you can go alone and make some new friends sitting at the bar.  I'll be back? - Who's going with me?  When - November 14, 2018 Why - Cocktails with Max, he's the man.

Homer Simpson wouldn't  eat these donuts.  I never thought I'd see the day when I'd find a donut I didn't like.  These are the most flavorless donuts I have experienced.     I can not comment on the customer service, the box of donuts were brought in by a co-worker.

It's just sad. The majority of this mall is empty and boarded up. What national chain stores that do remain, have not been updated in years.   On a positive note, if you're a mall walker, you can walk at a good speed. There will be no shoppers in your way.   Best thing this developer could do, is build a strip center on the outer edge of the parking lot, move the last valuable tenants and tear this dinosaur of a mall down.   Will I return? - Only for Olga's.   When: November 2, 2020 Why: Shopping Anchor and ventured out into mall

Are you ready to party? If not, you need to stay home, because when you come to Ballpark Village, it is a party. You'll have 4 restaurants to satisfy your food cravings and 6 bars to quench your thirst. When they have live music, you'll instantly have your dancing shoes on.   BV is a great place to meet before or after a baseball game and as we all recently witnessed it is also a great place to watch our hometown team during a run to a Stanley Cup victory. Let's Go Blues!   Downtown? Going to a ballgame? Want a fun time with friends? Get yourself over to Ballpark Village and let things naturally happen and it will be a good time.   I'll be back? - Let's play ball.  When: May 23, 2019 Why: Party!
They now deliver! Wish I could take credit for now offering this service, they started as soon as my comment appeared.....lol

I can't shop or go to the new Apple store without a Frappucino after-wards. It's just one of my unwritten rules. It's a refreshing treat to celebrate a new purchase or resisting the urge to make a new purchase.   I like the new store location over the old kiosk version. However, I disagree with John H., I think the line moves slower. Perhaps my line was longer then his, because they were moving slow. I found it odd that two associates were taking orders and only one making all our drinks. I may be crazy, but wouldn't the line moved faster if two were making the drinks?  We all know the baked goods are shipped in to each Starbucks. There are no Kebbler elves in the back stockroom baking. Even though they are shipped in, I love the petite vanilla bean scones.   Staff is always friendly and pleasant. They should be, Starkbucks treats their employees very well with benefits and $.

Going to make this review short and direct. I like this Target because it has a liquor department and the Target near my home does not. I am so jealous that a county Target has something my city Target does not. The county Target may have booze, but I will still remain a city resident.

This is my go to place for Chinese carry out when I am at work. It is a convenient location to get in and out of without any trouble. I work so close, that when I walk in the door to pick my phone order up, it is coming out of the wok. Making it so hot and fresh.   I love their fried rice, beef is my favorite. A half order is big enough for me to have two lunches. My lunch yesterday, I wish I would have taken a photo of the crab Rangoon, it was picture perfect and so was the taste. They by far make the best fast Chinese Crab Rangoon I have ever had and I think it may even beat PF Chang's.   The two Chinese carry out joints near home, have disappointed us recently. I am thinking the next time we have the craving at home, I will drive the extra distance for Park Chop Suey.

What a great bar!   It has everything you'd want.   1) Dimly lit. 2) Dive bar atmosphere 3) Well stocked bar and masterfully made cocktails 4) Outlets, USB ports and hooks under the bar 5) Friendly Bartenders  6) Diverse Crowd 7) Free shot at 10 PM compliments of, The Party.   The night I stopped by was their first and last night of karaoke. To be honest, none of the performers could carry a note. They all admitted it, but they still sang their hearts out and had fun. Best of all, the crowd cheered and applauded their performances.   It's so sad that the Cherokee District is losing this great bar, its last day of business will be the 18th. If you can go before this Saturday, I urge you to go and experience the fun of Propaganda.

Love a good cocktail? You'll love Intoxicology, because a good cocktail needs good liquor and good ingredients.   Intoxicology may be a chic little booze boutique in the trendy, Grove neighborhood, but their liquor pricing is very competitive. I was immediately impressed with the variety of brands they offered in such a small space. I was pleased to see that a local shop was offering and showcasing local distilleries. Local supporting local is always a win-win.   In addition to quality liquor, they offer vintage bar and glassware. They also offer a small selection of books about the art of mixology. I had to purchase the one about my favorite classic cocktail, The Manhattan. It was titled; Manhattan: Story of the First Modern Cocktail. Such a good read, with a Manhattan served up at my side.   Will I return? - I love, a good Manhattan  When: November 28, 2017 Why: It's that time of year.

Every so often, it is good to update the reviews of some of your favorite haunts. The Mack is close to my home, making it easy to grab a great char-grilled burger. Yesterday I stopped for a quick lunch and enjoyed a Four Cheese Burger. Did you hear that, Jack? Four Cheese! That kinda puts your Ultimate Cheeseburger to shame. My burger was char-grilled to a perfect medium rare and topped with cheddar, pepper jack, provel and american cheese. I paid the additional $1 and upgraded from regular fries to Criss-Cross Fries aka Waffle Fries.   In addition to great burgers, they offer up an amazing grilled chicken and steak sandwich as well. They also offer a large variety of craft beers on draught and in bottle. The atmosphere is a relaxed smoke-free neighborhood bar.

Oh, sweet baby Jesus. It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas and It's a Wonderful Life. If you are not in the Christmas spirit when you leave here, you definitely are a Scrooge. This is the place to be seen this holiday season.   The ambiance creates a fun filled atmosphere. This pop-up bar is decorated in trailer park tacky, but I LOVE it! Just like an ugly sweater party, it adds to the fun. They even have a section of the bar decorated for Hanukah.   Their specialty cocktails were all $12 and have cute holiday themed names. In addition to the cocktails, they created a special snacks menu ranging in price from $5 - $7. My personal favorite was the Lumps of Coal, a perfect snack for a naught boy. It was Oreo infused Rice Krispie treats.   The staff is bubbly and they make sure everyone is having a good time. You definitely come here to celebrate the season and have some good cheer.   Would I come back? If they continue to pop-up, I'll continue to come back.   When: December 13, 2016 Why: It's a Pop-UP Limited time open

This place is amazing! The selection is over whelming,  I felt like a child in a candy store. Once I got my focus, it was a great shopping experience.   If anyone needs new drawer pull, or any type of decorative hardware this is the only store in town to shop. They offer the best lines and some of the most creative.   The sales professionals are truly that, "professional". They listen to your needs and wants and guide you to fulfill your dreams.

Time for another update and this time John is being bumped up to 4 Stars. They are easily my co-workers choice, when it has  been designated donut day. Our favorites are the Chocolate Long John and the Glazed Buttermilk. Both are scrumptious. Our dozen is usually 6 of each.   Other donuts that you'll find in our box on occasion are; Cinnamon Twist, Apple Fritter, Cinnamon Roll and a traditional Glazed or Sugar donut. Depending on who is working, you may even see a Jelly Donut in our box.   The donuts are always super fresh. If you need coffee, I'll warn you, this is not Starbucks. John serves up a good strong cup of black coffee, the way it should be drank.   The staff is friendly. They remember their regulars and welcome new customers as if they were regulars.   I'd give John 5 Stars, but they're closed on Sunday and sometimes we really need donuts on Sunday morning. Otherwise, they are top-notch donuts.   Would I return? - I do every week.   When: I'm usually there Friday or Saturday Why: Keep my co-workers happy.

I was Saturday sometime between breakfast and lunch. I wasn't eating, but I still wanted a Bloody Mary. By chance I stopped by Cafe Lafitte and was totally blown away with the Bloody Mary they served up. Being a dive bar, I was expecting vodka and some bland BM mixer. I was totally wrong. I got a strong pouring of vodka, a spicy BM mixer and enough garnishment to snack on and satisfy me until I decided what I wanted to do for lunch.   I love Bloody Mary's so much, that I have a list dedicated to them here on Yelp. I consider this to be one of the best. It may be a dive gay bar, but it's Bloody Mary is better then some upscale restaurants. My one picture is now the wallpaper on my smartphone.   Great service too, the bartender let me use the outlet behind the bar to charge my phone.   When: August 27, 2016 Why: Steven needed a Bloody Mary

My favorite place to celebrate birthday or anniversaries. The service is very attentive, they make all guest fell like royalty. My personal favorites are the Pepper Fillet or Pepper Strip (can you tell I like Pepper). However, they have some of the best Prime Rib I have ever experienced. Bake Potatoes are huge, for an extra $1 you can make it "Sweet" and it's worth every penny. Asparagus is one of my favorite vegetables and I highly recommend getting a side of this green treat. May be a few extra $'s but the experience and food are worth it!

It's not Christmas without a trip to Intoxicology. When the majority of the people you buy gifts for are cocktail snobs, this is the place to find the absolute perfect gift.   Intoxicology has some of the best premium liquors and mixers.  Today I was shopping for bitters to complete a whiskey gift box I was creating. Oh, my they had so many for me to choose from. They even had small gift box of multiple samples to give the recipient variety. If your not the creative type, or just want things simple and done for you, they had pre-made gift boxes. Which makes gift giving, easy-peasy.   I admit, I am a garnish snob. If I'm drinking a premium liquor in a craft cocktail, I want a garnish to be of the same quality and Intoxicology has what I need. They've got the dark cherries for my Manhattans and olives for my Dirty Martini.   The gentleman woking is always friendly and makes shopping in his shop a pleasant experience. That is why I enjoy shopping local and supporting a small business.   When: December 4, 2020 Why: Holiday Gifts

Awesome! We rented the penthouse for a bridal happy hour shower and it was the perfect event space for our thirty guest. Having a full kitchen, island and huge dining table gave us plenty of service space for all the booze and food. The large living room was roomy and allowed all the guest to gather around as the bride opened all her gifts.   The penthouse also has two bedrooms each with its own bathroom and a laundry room. Everyone joked how they could live here. It truly is that homey and comfortable.  A true highlight was huge and I do mean huge balcony with a view of the majestic Mississippi river. A gas grill and two dining tables on the balcony would be perfect for a 4th of July party to view the fireworks.   After the BHHS, a select group of the ladies spent the night and loved it.  This is a hidden gem in the Alton area. If you need a B &B in the Riverbend area, I highly recommend the Alton Cracker Factory.   I'll be back? - If the opportunity arises & highly recommend.   When: April 28, 2019 Why: Bridal Shower in Penthouse

3 is my luck number and evidently it is Laurie's Shoes too. Why you ask, because every time I shop here I walk out with 3 pairs of shoes.  I use to buy my shoes at one of those "warehouse" type stores where you wait on yourself, until I went to Laurie's with a friend. I was just tagging along, so I thought. I was amazed at the customer service and knowledge that the sales staff had about selecting the right size and fit. My feet have never felt better.  I've become addicted, all my shoes have now been from Laurie's. They've provided me with dress, work, casual loafers and even a pair of Reef Flip-Flops that have a bottle opener in the sole. Which has proved to be very handy at summer BBQ's.  Next time you need shoes, I highly recommend visiting Laurie's and seeing if you become as hooked as I have.

Today was my first day shopping at this Aldi and I can already tell you it will not be the last. I was amazed at the produce selection and the low prices. The variety may have been smaller then other major stores, but the quality is the same. So, I'll save $'s and buy some of my produce here.  Aldi's is also a good place to stock your pantry with daily staples, or buy the basics for party. Once the unknown brand of roasted peanuts are poured in bowl, no one will know they are not Fisher's or Planters. The same will stand true for those tortilla chips and salsa. I also like their selection and prices on cheese and who can beat a dozen eggs for $1.59.   Store is clean and the staff is friendly and helpful, making this a good place to shop for groceries. So the next time you get a circular in the mail for Aldi's, check it out before throwing it in to the recycling. You will be surprised at what they offer and the prices.

This is a poor excuse of a store for H&M. In my opinion it is the "red headed step child" of the chain. It has the poorest selection and variety of merchandise. Not to mention the worst customer service.    My visit last week had me wondering if Kennelwood had not been there and installed an invisible fence around the check out counter. While I shopped, the only two associates I saw, stayed behind the counter discussing their previous night dates in a volume that could be heard in the middle of the store. I approached to ask a question and was given a short quick answer, "no". They then went back to their conversation.  I then continued my shopping at another store in the mall.

Love me some, Lion's Choice. It is a quick and easy fast food fix. The Roast Beef is always so tender and juicy. I like the fact that there actually is a little red tint to it.  Other fast food places, over cook their RB, leaving it dried out. The seasoning, also puts Lion's Choice above the others.  Speaking of their seasoning, it is now available for purchase in their restaurants. I've grabbed a couple of bottles to use as fill-in's for some of my holiday gifts. Spices/Seasonings are always great gifts for a foodie friend.   To accompany their sandwiches, their long thin fries are always hot and crisp. I use a combination of BBQ Sauce and Ketchup for dipping. For those who are fans of horseradish on their sandwich, Lion's Choice offers it as a condiment.   Other highlights, that set LC above that other fast food place that serves, "the meats" is crushed ice and soft serve ice cream cones. Oh, I don't want to forget to mention, Orange Freezes. Yummy!

Farewell, Joanie. A friend organized a party at your Pizzeria, so we all could say good-bye. I had never been, so it was a first and last time for me.   Being on a diet, I didn't order pizza. I enjoyed a Caesar Salad and their house made dressing was top notch. I also had an order of Buffalo Wings, that was a special that evening. For pizzeria wings, they were pretty tasty.   Our server was accommodating and friendly. She said business had jumped up drastically, since the closure announcement. However, it's still too late to save the business.    It's sad to see a local business close, especially one who had been open as long as Joanie's. However, from my one visit, I could tell it hadn't changed much since it's opening and perhaps that was the downfall.   When: February 5, 2020 Why: Announced Closing

In my humble opinion, New Balance tennis shoes are the best. I've tried other brands, but I always come back to NB. I'm also a creature of habit and select the plain white on white walking shoe. To add a little pizzaz to my shoes I pick up some colorful laces to coordinate with my shirts.   Another reason I like getting my new NB's here, is the knowledgeable sales associates. They listen to my needs and measure my feet for the appropriate size. Today, I got lucky and the shoe I wanted was even on sale. I'll take that as a win.   My sales associate today, recommended inserts for my shoes. I was amazed at the difference they made my feet feel. Being one who is on his feet and does a lot of walking, I was sold. You can purchase NB at many of the supermarket or warehouse shoe stores, but the customer service here makes it worth the trip.   Will I return? Yes -   When: July 10, 2017 Why: New walking shoes

Heating and Air Conditioning are things we all need to keep ourselves comfortable in this miserable Missouri weather.  To keep my heating & cooling equipment in tip top condition, I use Martin - Jetco.  I started out using M-J for my seasonal check-ups and when it was time to upgrade my system it was almost a no brainer. Even though I knew the end result, I still got other bids for both new heating and air conditioning. I was right, Martin - Jetco beat everyone hands down.   I love my new system, I've experienced both seasons and have been both toasty warm and chilly cool. Of course I have them come prior to every cooling/heating season to make sure everything is performing at its best.   Hometown biz, excellent customer service and quality work.

I was drug here while taking a friend around the neighborhood to run errands. I had not been here since my last visit back in 2015. I did not venture very deep into the store. We only shopped the grocery and meat department.   I will say that their prices were not that impressive on the staple items I checked. However, I will say that the meats looked good and the prices were similar to those that I see and pay at my Costco. The grocery area was clean and well maintained.   The check-out was a nightmare. It was just like all the stories I've heard. Only two cashiers working and both of them were working slow as molasses. I do not use self checkouts, but I was so tempted to do on this visit.   I'm not a Wal-Mart supporter. I'm not a fan of the Walton's or Stan Kroenke. If you are, this is was of the better stores. Just beware of the parking lot, it gets kind of crazy.

I've been a steady customer of their E-ville store for a year now and I can say the service and product offerings are as good as their flagship store in STL.   The variety of dry and moist foods for both canine and feline is impressive. If you're wanting to change up your fur-babies diet, talk with one of the sales associates and they'll be able to guide you to  one or more of their offerings.  They can even help you find the perfect bag of treats to make your best friend a happy snacker.   My dogs are so spoiled they have their own closet in between the kitchen and laundry room. It's filled with different bowls, leashes, collars, dry and moist food and a variety of treats. I'm pleased to say, it all came from Four Muddy Paws. They're the best when shopping for your best friend.

Disclaimer: The owner reached out to me after my initial review and treated me and coworkers to another pizza. He was truly concerned about the service we received and wanted to make things right.   I will say this time it was a drastic improvement. The service on the phone and delivery person were both polite and personable. The delivery was quick and the pizza was piping hot.   Now that we have made amends with Papa, he may not be in our house, but he has been in our office multiple times. For pizza downtown, it is quick, fresh and delivered fast.

Close, convenient and cheap.   It is an open lot with no covered parking spaces, but if you choose the the entrance on the right and go straight there are some amazing white pine trees that provide shade for your ride.   The shuttle drivers are friendly and helpful. One member of our group of six forgot he had a pocketknife in his "pocket" when he arrived at the SW terminal to be dropped off. The driver took the pocketknife back to our travelers  SVU and slipped it into the wiper well. When we returned from our trip, the knife was there waiting to be reunited with its owner.   Arriving back to STL, we were picked up by an equally friendly driver and returned to our vehicles. The daily rate here is $8 and that is a deal. When I fly, this is where I park my ride.

Wow! What Penzeys is to spices Vom Fass is too oils, vinegars and liquors. You can find those hard to find ingredients for that special new recipe. That staff is very knowledgeable, friendly and will guide you through an amazing shopping experience.  You not only get to select your oils and vinegars, you select the container and size. When you got back for your next purchase (I know you'll go back) - take your empty container and have it refilled. How "green friendly" can you get.  Their liquors are amazing too. Treat your vodka and scotch friends to a small bottle of their amazing varieties - you'll become their BFF.

I have worn glasses or contact lenses since I was 10 years old. So I have had my share of eye examinations and I am here to tell you the best is Koetting Associates.   You will get the most extensive and thorough eye examination you have ever experienced. As you are being examined, you'll wonder why your previous doctor never did each of the test that KA completes on your eyes. Before you enter the examination room for your vision, you are taken to a separate room for approximately 8 different test.  These extra test, is what puts them ahead of the class. Being over 40 now and having monovision, I appreciate the extra time they take making sure my distance and closeup vision are both good.   The entire staff from Dr. Castellano to the receptionist are professional and personable. Thanks to their professionalism, I can see clearly now.

I discovered this place to late in my visit to the French Quarter. It was Sunday afternoon when Marielle told about Vacherie. When I went after the Yelp Summer Splash Social, I discovered on Sunday evenings they have limited service.   However, I was able to enjoy a refreshing vodka cocktail and and an order of Brussels Sprouts with bacon at the bar. Vodka is my booze of choice and Sprouts are one of my favorite vegetables, so I was still a happy diner.  On Sunday they have Happy Hour 3-7 PM and serve an abbreviated dinner at the bar 6-10 PM.   When: August 28, 2016 Why: Dinner, but settled for Happy Hour

This Nordstrom Rack is proof that bigger is not always better. This NR is larger then the one on Brentwood, but lacks in selection that the smaller one has near The Galleria. I also, did not like the floor plan. It lacked the easy flow that the Brentwood location has. However, this location had a staff that was friendlier and more helpful.   I was shopping for summer short sleeve cotton shirts to go along with some of my solid colored shorts. A man can only wear so many Polo shirts. The selection here was not that good and the prices really were not any better then a sale price at the regular Nordstrom or Macy's. I finally did find a pink madras one that will go great with my pink shorts.   For my Rack shopping, I will continue to be a supporter of the smaller Brentwood store and let this bigger store for the west county patrons.

I love this place! I am so thankful that I finally made it here. My friends have been raving about it for months, but I just never made it here. Once I did, it was love at first sight. It has a simple ambiance, racks of craft beer that you can buy by the six pack or mix and match buying single bottles and creating your own six pack.   I have been searching for a particular beer since my Colorado vacation in 2013 and have not been able to find it at any other liquor store in STL. When I was told by one of the cool employees what they were serving on draft that day, I squealed with glee. They were serving my favorite Colorado beer from Great Divide, Orabelle. They also had my second favorite, Colette.   When shopping for Craft Beer, I will now come to  CBC. They had my beer, when other stores in town told me they couldn't find it and that I'd have to buy something else. CBC you are my hero and you are rock stars in my eyes.

I had recently bought some new upholstered furniture at another store and mainly was looking for accent tables and possibly new dining table and chairs. I was not impressed with they're going out of business sale. The prices are still fairly high for the quality product you are getting.   They still have a lot of merchandise left and IMHO, it is ugly. My suggestion to Mr. Phillips is take the inventory and move to your Weekends Only Store and call it a day.

Great place for breakfast if you live in the neighborhood, but it is not worth the drive. We drove across town for the experience.  We had the American and English Breakfasts, both had a good presentation. The bacon was good and I love the fact that the ham was thinly sliced. Both were cured well. The eggs cooked over easy, were a little over done and the scrambled eggs were fluffy and flavorful. The Roasted Potatoes, were not roasted at all - big disappointment.   Another disappointment was the service, it was minimal and I do mean minimal. They did as little as possible to make you feel welcome or to come back. Chances are, we will not go back.

Some of the best things in life are never the same in our lovely hometown. All I can hope is that once the "A" grade Nordstrom at the St. Louis Galleria opens that our Rack will improve. Right now this rack reflects the "C" grade Nordstrom that is at the West County Center.   Nordstrom Rack offers some incredible buys for men, but not at this Rack. I can only hope that the ladies department is better. I guess I'll continue to do my Rack shopping when I am out of town.

This is the friendliest & most helpful staff I've ever experienced in a Walgreens. They make my visits before work totally enjoyable. I just wish they had the variety & selection of the Walgreens that is closer to my home. Oh, well, it helps me try new products.

They tore down an old fashioned style Taco Bell at this location and built this new ultra modern Taco Bell. It offers Wi-Fi and outlets at the tables and booths for your electronic devices. This allows you to stay connected while you enjoy a quick fast food lunch. I will say, the new building is a vast improvement over the old.   The menu is still the same, fast food Mexican that will satisfy a craving and give you heartburn or gas afterwards. I agree with Josh J., the customer service is lacking. The night I stopped in for a couple of Combos for a lazy night dinner, the cashier was more occupied flirting with a young lady then servicing ordering patrons. He rushed us through one by one and in between, kept flirting hoping to make a "score".    The tacos were good by TB standards.  I also ordered a Bean Burrito, which was a disappointment. The tortilla was cold, tough and chewy.   I really do not  recommended for lunch or dinner. If you've been out drinking and have a fair amount of liquor in your system, give it a go.

Porter's produces a flavorful chicken that is crispy on the outside, moist and tender on the inside. Their boxed dinners include cole slaw and mashed potatoes with a mass produced dinner roll.  The cole slaw is excellent, wish my local deli's slaw was as good. Mashed potatoes are mashed potatoes, and the white gravy is better then the brown gravy you get at KFC.   The staff is friendly and accommodating to your request. We wanted one of our dinners to be all thighs and it was no problem. My only question is, who carves their chickens. The thighs and breast are cut stranger then I have ever seen. Hey, I can over look a weird cut, when the flavor is this good, but inquiring minds still want to know.

If I lived in New Orleans, Addiction would be my Addiction for coffee. What a great find, on the Yelp app.. Everything about this little coffee shop is unique. Creativity flows from the beverages and out into the ambiance and marketing. Take your time and relax. There is so much that will catch your eye and stimulate your mind. The music playing will also take you away into another dimension.   I got a giggle out of the verbiage they used for selling their beverages. It wasn't called a, "menu" it was referred to as; "The Goods". It was then broken down into three categories; Habit - Fix - Lit. My beverage of choice was the last one listed under, Lit. I was craving a cold brew. The barista commented that I had made a good choice. He then asked if I liked it black and I told him that was how coffee was intended to be drank.   Great service, great coffee and it is all at an affordable price. If you're in the French Quarter, stop by and you too will be addicted to Addiction.   When: August 28, 2016 Why: Cold Brew

Three cupcakes today; Pumpkin Spice, Peanut Butter and Red Velvet. I will admit all three had great flavor, with the Pumpkin Spice leading the way. However, even though they all had great flavor, they all lacked moistness. All three cupcakes were extremely dry. If one were dry and the other two were moist, I'd kept them at 4 Stars. When all three end up being a dry cake, they lose a star. Thank God, for a cold glass of milk.

Porters does chicken well, but they lost a star for their Cod Fish. The pieces were square. I wanted the catfish, but was informed it would be a 20 minuet wait. To save time, I went with Cod. Big mistake, not only was it square, but had a greasy nasty taste. I've heard good things about the catfish, so next time I will order ahead, so I will not have to wait.   We also enjoyed the Chicken Tender Dinner tonight and it was a winner. It included four huge pieces of white meat chicken, that were crispy and juicy. These tenders were way better then those you'd get at any other fast food type business.  My bad choice of Cod Fish caused them a star, but I am confident once I experience the Catfish the stars will go back up.

When I'm in the area, I stop in and visit this B&NB. I don't shop the regular priced books, I shop the clearance and sale book tables. I especially like the books that are featured on sale in the entryway. That is where I always find the best bargains. I can always find a great cookbook for an upcoming gift. I have found some titles on clearance here, to be cheaper then Amazon. I didn't have to pay shipping and got instant satisfaction.   Staff isn't that friendly, but that could be because I only shop clearance....LOL.

Great little bookstore, they carry some off the wall titles that make them  in class of their own.  I love the little section that has books on local neighborhoods, restaurants  and history of St. Louis. Another thing I found very helpful were the shelf talkers that gave blurbs and recommendations on books. Also, look for bookmarks sticking out of the books, it means that it is autographed by the author.
Great gift boxes, I am sure they'll be a hit in the kitchen this year.  Shopping today was packed almost claustrophobic, but the staff was handling it and the shoppers were having a great time.

The customer service today was stellar and the store was bustling with holiday shoppers. The sales associates were multi-tasking, assisting shoppers and they were doing it all with positive attitudes.   We found gifts for those who were on our nice list and we even found some for those who were on the naughty list.  Of course you can never shop at Sur La Table without adding something to your own kitchen.  They could have gotten a 5 star rating if, a male manager and a female staff member were not having a conversation that should have been conducted in the stockroom or somewhere private. Shoppers did not need to hear the "drama".

Great store for party accessories. They have one aisle full of plates, napkins, cups and plastic-ware in every color imaginable. If you can not find a color to work with your party theme, I'd be surprised.   My recent visit here was to pick up goodies for a 60th birthday celebration. I found a DVD that highlights all the news, music, sports and movies of 1953. I also found several typical joke gifts for the celebration. My personal favorite resembles crime tape, but says "caution 60th birthday celebration in progress".   The customer service here is minimal. I was greeted on the sales floor, but when I said I was okay they quickly went on their way. No friendly chat to up-sell. I thought retail associates were there to increase sales. The cashier was quick to ring me out, but again no friendly conversation to encourage me to return for future party needs.   Great store for party needs you'll find almost anything you need for a fun party, but they need to improve their customer service.

KSDK just did a news story on this Walgreens, showing how friendly the staff is.  So glad others have noticed what I did over a year ago.  The staff here are superstars especially Mae.   They should have this staff do the customer service training for all Bi-State Walgreens.
