This type of food is normally seen in Muslim India, Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Iran, Iraq, Kenya, Kuwait, and more. It is very colorful rice and some with meat like chicken, goat or beef.   The buffet here is a bit expensive. It does have the good veggies section with at least 10 choices. The meat section has 8 choices. It Clyde tandoori chicken, biryani chicken, curry chicken and more. The price is rather above average among the area located which is USF.   I like the sweet Mango Kesari. It is good dessert. The service is good. It worth the money.

I think about 3.5 stars. Mainly is the price and the offer of the material are not measure up. My review is only focused on the shave ice. Not the drink. The drink may be speak differently. But shave ice is at the high side in compare to the same area cafe along the Park Blvd.   We have the strawberry shave ice. Any topping will be additional cost. Which make this an expensive item for the initial price. We did add the rainbow jelly. The ice already has the flavor before they shave it. This is typical Taiwanese ice making process. It is delicious.   The place is popular now. May be they need to think about some offer now to keep the customers coming. If they do it, it will last a bit longer.

This restaurant we have came a few time I finally have a chance to try it. The first time we are here they have close during the day of the week, second time was too busy. The third time we finally have a chance to try their happy hour menu. Love it.   We started with Moroccan Spice Wing. The marinated or seasoning is special. Wing is good. The second dish is the tuna tartare. The tuna is fresh and well sauce. The wonton skin is crispy to accommodate the tuna. The third dish is the creole style crab cake. This dish has good meat burn side of crab cake. I like this method better. The quantity is small. The last item is the Korean St. Louis Rib. This dish I like the most. The rib is well prepared. Perfectly grilled. The sauce is beautifully done.   Overall our experience is great. Love the food. Chef has good technique on grilled. Very good use of sauce. Definitely like to try other things in the menu. The construction on the street make it difficult to get to.

Just like to agree with the rest of Yelper. 4 stars. It is good to have their weekday specials. It is $3.95 a roll. The special is about six pieces per roll. They also has the weekend special for 50% off on the second roll. The week end special are specialty roll.   The decorations of the restaurant is contemporary. I would give them a good effort for the bathroom details. During the lunch time, not too many people. We order the spicy tuna, spicy yellow tails, spicy scallops, Tampa roll, eel avocado, and the Boston roll. The food is good. The spicy scallops has the most tasty flavor.   Food is fresh. It take 15 minutes for six roll to make. The important is the rice. They do have the right ideal about the rice seasoning. It right amount of rice. Close out is good.

Rubio is a nicely presented new fast food with actually a comfort food of America with Mexican background. Are they true authentic Mexican food, probably not. But I can said it is fusion Mexican food.   We have order the Coastal Trio and Salsa Verde Shrimp two taco plate. It is order on the counter and the food bring to the table. The grilled fish and shrimp are average. Yes, they show grilled mark but grilled technique should be have smoke flavor or grilled mark burn meat flavor. The fried fish is good.   The main reason they are average is the food is a big blend. However they have good interior decoration. Place is very clean may be they still new. Salsa is more in liquidity stage instead of chop up process. This tell you fast food process because it is easy to produce liquid than chop up.

The restaurant location has been through many other types of restaurant before today Mediterranean Cuisine. I wish they doing well since they do have good food. Winning the support of the customers is important. Such as doing something different than other Mediterranean cuisine restaurant typically do. One improvement can be done definitely has all dinner or meal with multi sides to accompany. Currently they allow one side which I feel to little and not comparable to the near by restaurant has done.   I have chicken kabab and the lamb chop dinner. The chicken kabab I choose the baba ghanoush. The Baba ghanoush was delicious. The chicken was grilled with juicy meat and marinated sauce. It is a good dish to have. The lamb chop I have choose the yellow rice. The lamb chop was very nicely done. As I said above, for the price they have, they may want to include another side.

It one of good seafood place in Dunedin. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars. The reason they stay at 4 stars due to service during lunch time. They have one waiter and reception for the afternoon. I can see 6 table of customers but not enough waitress. Obviously this is a balancing act for the restaurant if they need to spend more overhead.   With that said. The food are excellent. 5 stars. We started with fried crab crawl. This is special of the day. $12 for about 20 crawls. The crawl is fresh with great coating. Love it.   Our main dish is oyster poboy and the blackened hogfish. They give a lot of oyster at the poboy. The oyster are great. My friend was not able to finish and take home. The hogfish blackened is ok. Not like the Cajun style. But the fish meat is good and tasty. It is good sandwich.   Overall experience is good. Hope they continue the good food.

4.5 stars restaurant. Not yet 5 stars to my book. This restaurant has plus at back of the name. This mean they beyond just poke only. The restaurant also has the Vietnamese cuisine. So you can get poke and cook meal. I got best of both worlds.   I start with mixed poke. I got the base as rice and protein as tuna. They are generous for one scoop of protein. This is why they have 5 stars. I got all the mixed in ingredients and topping that have have no up charge. The sauce are poke sauce, eel and special ask for sesame oil. It was really good for mixed in. I would pre them to do mixed in ingredients and protein separately than added into the base then add topping. But they don't have this procedure. They do put the sauce over base then on top of mixed in ingredients. This area they can improve.   We also got the combination pho and grilled pork bun. Their Vietnamese side food also delicious. The grilled pork is well marinated and their pho is deep with herb smell.

#ThankYouThursday.   I have chosen Terra Gaucha for today visit for lunch dine in experience. Thank you for hanging there during pandemic. I think your restaurant has good high ceiling dining hall. No doubt the great Brazilian Grille in Tampa Bay Area. We were lucky to have you. Interior design is great. Good place for power lunch and bring the the client.   With that said. This is place for meat. Love it. Buffet style. People may be afraid of close contact because of buffet. Thank you to make it safer for people come to the table. Before each individual come to the buffet booth, each one need to put on the hand gloves. So the share spatula is not touch. The buffet table already have partial cover on top. But I think more cover or complete lid cover is better. We saw a few completely cover such as soup item is very good.   The meat bring to the table is well perform. Server wear gloves and mask. Definitely great to visit. Keep serving our community and we are looking forward to see you again.

Very close to 4.5 stars restaurant. I would said they are good enough in this area. In fact, they are better than most of the Japanese restaurant which serves by non Japanese chef. I believe many enjoy the food once they have the sashimi.   Restaurant is kind of tuck away in the plaza. Not visible to the Main Street. We got bento box special and the Arizona roll. We are kind of in hurry for a movie but we didn't tell them so. However, the speed of the serving, we were able to finish at 35 minutes.   I like my bento box. It has sashimi, sushi, California roll, goyoza, teriyaki chicken, tempura shrimp and veggies. Accompanying with salad and soup. I like the way they prepared the sashimi. The fish was glazed with sesame oil. Nice touch. The temperature is crispy and evenly spread of flour. I like they special made goyoza. The infill include meat and scallions. Very nice. All fish is in good size.   Overall very good experience.

Old Navy definitely is the most like by many people. Their clothing are made to American style and widely accepted by general population. Their price of the clothing is affordable that welcome by many consumer. This is one of my wife favorites store just to shop. May be she can find something she like.   It was always easy for us to visit when we have extra time before the cinema show. They very close to the cinema. It is obvious visit for close proximity. There have their fashion statement to fit the typical people who looking for.

It an interesting local produce place. The location of the store is actually close to the county line but not at county line. It is one street south of the county line at Hillsborough County.   They have good piece of farm property at Lutz. It is large enough for the farm, building and food truck. The entrance may need some fixed up for the big hole cumulate the rain water.   The produce they have is one of the kind. Basically have fresh veggies, home made drink, olive oil, soft drink and more. I got the cane soda. This cola made from sugar cane water. It is interesting. Their fresh fruit are store at the refrigerator to maintain freshness. This is the place I saw sell fresh blackberry juice.

Solid 4 stars. Very close to 4.5 stars. If they have more creative side, they probably 5 stars. This take out BBQ place is Riverview jewels. Many come here for the pickup food. The peach cobbler should not be miss. This is the item I recommend.   We have the family meal deal with three meat types and 3 sides and a peach cobbler as a deal. The meat are ribs, chicken and pulled pork. The best is the rib. I like the way the have the rib with seasoning stick to the surface. The sons is the chicken. The sides we have is the yellow rice, garlic potatoes and collard greens. The best is the garlic potatoes.   The deal is good for $25. It is in good quantity. The wait is good to order on side. Many call in. The smoke house just right outside.

Currently the restaurant are not open for public to dine in. It is takeout only. In order to attract customers and regularity, they push out several rewards systems. They have clover points system. 50 point cumulative got the free peach pudding with milk. 100 point got Tao Beef Burrito, 200 point spicy chicken and 300 whole grilled fish. Basically is 10% off item you cumulative as point.   The also run weekly half price promotions. Currently is the grilled lamb leg half price. You can choose spicy or salt and pepper. I prefer the salt and pepper. It is delicious. Other item include dong Po pork belly, fiery shrimp are among the best. You should try those dishes. The lunch special is comparable with and fast food outside with great value. It also includes a soft drink and make the deal sweet with about $8. Can beat that.   Call ahead is the key. They usually need 20 minutes to prepare. Food are very nicely seasoned and go with wine at home. Are you hungry now.

About 4.25 stars. This newly added location is similar to the one at River View. But I think they are better location in compare to the one they have in River View. I like open space compare to restaurants that previously here.   We were here since we know their sister company at the south. I have the Spaghetti Ortolano with grilled shrimp. I kind of changed the protein on this dish. It turn our very well. The ingredients included pine nuts, green bean, asparagus, broccoli, tomato. This pasta dish is harmony to go with grilled shrimp. We also got the Chicken Parmesan with pasta. The chicken is breaded. Both dishes are excellent.   The food is on time. We were lucky to beat the Sunday lunch crowd. Not much of wait. The restaurant filled up in 30 minutes. So go early on Sunday.

I have been to this house two year ago close to Christmas. The owner always has the fun to set up the Christmas light and attract a lot of visitors. The entrée is free but suggest for donations to keep up the cost.    The whole front yard is cover with Christmas light. They have good nativity scene with arc light over it. The trees is completely wrapped with light. Giant size snow man blow with air. Bubble fill with sky. Charles Stanley preached the sermon. These is the few set they do. The model train section with amusement park has a lot of moving part. The section with light show is dancing.  I like their North Pole penguin set up.   There many photo spot opportunity. We took many of that. They even have people direct the traffic to keep vehicles moving. Street side parking is available.

This food truck located a the empty land. The entrance is from Old SR 54 not the Wesley Chapel Blvd.  the map may take you at non entrance way. They do have pepinos, patacone, cachapa and more. Is is Venezuelan food. Price is at the high side.   I got the carne mechada (shredded beef). It look beautiful. The beef is a lot. I also like the fried patacone. It was crispy. The Venezuelan cheese is delicious. The sauce was well made.   From order to finish is about 10 minutes. I don't mind the wait to get the freshly fried patacone.

Review #2900. Rare ethnic food #70. Iraqi Cuisine.   This review go to our local unique restaurant. I have many Middle Eastern food but this one is different. If you come to visit, I would suggest get the Iraqi Masgouf fish dish. The restaurant has very interesting meat dish in the menu. All food is interesting.   We got the Iraqi Masgouf. This dish is not cheap but it has good quantity and quality. The entire come with marinated grilled fish. The side dish have Fries, green chili, butter bread, two mixed veggies, and more. The fish is delicious with bone. The other dish we have is the  dolce ribeye steak. This dish we select the rice. I like the spice up rice. The steak was well marinated. It is tasty to the bone.   The restaurant has a yellow bird. It sing for us while we are eating. The chai tea is complimentary. The soup was special complimentary. We got the lentil and the okra soup. Service is good. Love to eat there for good food. The bread is special with their own made butter.

Cinco De Mayo weekend, our office pick this restaurant to have the lunch before the week is over. This restaurant is hidden at temple terrace in a small plaza. If I don't have yelp, I would not have found it.   They have $5 lunch special and margarita special. I have order one margarita and it come with 32 oz glass. Giant glass!!! It almost cannot fit my face. I have asked the help from my friend to take a sip.   I have ordered the steak quesadilla, it come with lettuce and tomato. The steak is stir fried in flour taco. It is decent. Taste is good. I have added a dessert at the end with fried dough with cinnamon, powder sugar and honey.   Service is friendly, food came out fast, the atmosphere is great. This is about 3.5 stars restaurant. Please check them out. Definitely a very budget lunch.

A little above 4 stars. Because of the good flavors. They located at Seminole Height. Parking is at the side street. The seating is limited at interior but they do have the courtyard seating share with the chicken place next door.   They have vegan or veggies bowl. We got the surf and turf bowl. It is included the grilled shrimp and steak. I like it they cook your order. They grilled the steak right when you order it. Good seasoning to the steak and shrimp. The choices of the topping is by yourself. I like the broccoli and Brussels sprouts. Our base is the noodle. Every thing is great. Even the sauces are creative to be added on.   Not much service. The workers there are very friendly with a smile. Love the food and we will be back to try other item. A+ on the seasoning and the sauce accompanying it.

This is brand new Brazilian Steakhouse. It is a chain restaurant with well train staff to get this restaurant run smoothly at the first month. The lunch is cheaper than the dinner. The all you can eat steak also includes all you can eat buffet for other miscellaneous items.   The steak is awesome. Especially I like the lamb chop, chicken heart, skirt steak, top sirloin. All steak is well seasoning. Especially the chicken heart and chicken drum stick. The chicken drum stick is marinated in wine sauce. Very delicious. There are wave and wave of meat to cut. They also bring out big giant leg of lamb.   During this time on the brand new opening, they have 10% off the bill. On the buffet table, they have heart of palm, Smoke salmon, caramel mushrooms and more.   Tip - don't forget to ask for the steak sauce such chimichuri, hot sauce, mint jelly to go with steak and lamb chop.   Service is excellent. These include the speed, attention to detail, clean up, and frequently check on the table. Definitely 5 stars.

Yummy House is alway to go restaurant. My recent visit drop a stars. Mainly is the taste and quantity. They still hold good menu selections. But I think the menu is reduced items. During pandemic and inflation, the price did increase by 20%.   The main reason they deducted a stars from my previous review is the quantity of the protein is reduced and the price increase. They no longer the most economical restaurants. You can tell the customer also reduced during dinner time. Lunch time is still a lot of customers especially weekends due to dim sum.   I also feel their best chefs is no longer here. Food taste is a bit less than their branch at Ocala.

Oh well, this is average among the restaurant over here. Marrow do have some Americans cuisine. However, what I take for this restaurant may not measure to the value you paid while other restaurant may be do better than them.   We were here to try their food first time. We have the Tavern 'slammin' steak sandwich. With upgrade side to grilled asparagus it is close to $20 dish. I expect this should be smashing dish. It turn out the meat is is just few cold cut on hot bun. I have give them with nice skirt steak. But it is cold cut. The upgrade asparagus only come in 4 strings.   The second dish is better. The chicken stack. It is grilled. Also about same price I have for steak sandwich. In compare to near by restaurant, I think the nearby restaurant may be better. I know the competition is tough. But I think they can do better.   Our service is good. Just some time they waitress not paid the highest attention to our table during meal. But when get paid, it was quick.

For the BBQ they are about middle of the pack in Tampa. Their combo compare to many place they are right portion not the generous portion.   We got the combo package with collard greens and sweet corn as side. The main meat is the hog feed and the rib and brisket. The hog feed is the pull pork. I think the rib is better. Brisket is just good. We also got the pork sandwich. Their food is good but not to jump out the seat.   Price is a bit in the expensive side. May be create something attractive to the side items will attract more business. I do like the choice of the sauce. We got the mango sauce and the guava sauce. It is interesting.

This is the restaurant we have visited sometime ago and finally I have sometime to write about it. Havana 86 is the restaurant may be open during pandemic. We visited two months ago. I like the restaurant because it has good Cuban cuisine. Especially this area has already many Cuban restaurants close. I am happy they open their door.   We started with Tostones Rellenos - stuff fried green plantain. We got the stuffing at lobster. It comes with 5 pieces and delicious to share. For the main course, we have Vaca Frita and Churrasco ala Cubana. The vaca frita can be a little crispy by pan grilled longer. The skirt steak is delicious.   Overall the food is good. It is close to 4.5 stars. Price is affordable. Hopefully they keep it this way. Service is ok nothing jump out.

If you come drink is good. If you come for food, this may not a good choice. World of beer surprise me that they serve food. However, the food come out of the kitchen is too slow. Menu do not have good choices.   I got one of the special mojito. But I feel the cocktail is too light on the alcohol percentage. The drink feel like soft drink. Unless you go with their draft beer or bottle beer. Other than that, I not recommend their cocktails.   We order three tacos for snacks, it take 30 minutes to come out. I think this area need big improvement. The shrimp taco save them one stars. If not it is 2.5 stars.

It is about 3.5 stars. The lobster is definitely better quality than most lobster roll I have. They do have body meat not like most restaurants mainly crawl meat and the body sold to other dish. The preparation is butter lobster. I actually like this way better because you can taste the freshness of the lobster.   They have three different size of the roll. 2 oz to 4 oz selection. You also go to mega roll foot long with 10oz to share. They also has the lobster fried or Macaroni to try. Other than lobster, hot, burger, fish sandwich also available.   The truck just park outside. You can order the inside the brewery and they will give you a wait table. Food is great. I would said a good lobster roll in Tampa. I would suggest at least 3 oz roll.

I would said above average restaurant. This is local favorite restaurant which get a high review. The choice of the restaurants are not much in Wesley Chapel. I would said they are one of the better one in this area.  We have the mixed grilled, lamb pita, and the appetizer. The appetizer has some sour material in it to create the appetite. This is a good start. The mixed grilled is decent. Meat may need a bit more heavy seasoning. It can improve the meat by sealing the juice of the meat.   I saw the price range has went up since other people review not long ago. They have been adjusting their pricing quite often. They are getting with competing with Greek fast food chain may lose this batter since they are in very remote area with less customer traffic. I would said for the current value, they are about 3.5 stars.

A good barrier island food off the Pinellas county gulf coast. Rick is look like back to normal after pandemic. The customer come back to enjoy the mixed cocktails and food. It is St. Pete beach area restaurant. I pick this place after my visit to my project.   I order the grilled grouper sandwich. It come with the side. And I got the deep corn on the cob. I have not have a deep fried corn in Florida. I have deep fried corn once at New Orlean. The corn is very delicious. I recommend this side order if you come here. The outward of the corn has apply a layer of salty coating. It match the corn sweetness. The grouper is fresh. Seem like fresh catch of the day. My friend has a he shrimp pasta. He like it and finish the entire bowl.   Overall the service is good. I did not try their cocktails. But the food is good and has some unique item.

This Kung Fu tea is in the middle of the pack. We got the coffee slush with boba and the winter melon milk tea. I agree with Vivian that they need to improve the mixologist of the tea. Somehow it do not have the taste of harmony. The ingredients is good. The honey boba is still very good. But the the tea bitterness need to tone down. Caffeine is well maintained but the the tea bitterness somehow need to reduce. Milk is a bit heavy compare to many milk tea I have tasted.   This restaurant has token ramen section. We did not try their food this time. But will plan next visit to try their hot food. I like the open kitchen with glass wall allow the customers see their food preparation. It has increased the interest of the food.

There are so many poke place pop up lately. This is second poke island I have seen. I like it particularly is their choices of the protein. They have something that other poke place do not offer. The protein has eel, Tempura shrimp, tomago, squid. These items is not normally serve.   They have served a Yummy sauce which is spicy sesame is lovely. Mixed it with eel and poke sauce will make this perfect. I would said one part of yummy and poke sauce and two part of eel sauce is the way I like it. It you don't want it sweet, just use one part of eel sauce. I like the way they have the sauce on the rice first then pile all ingredients and sauce on the top. To make better, I would suggest sauce and ingredients mixed and put over rice. Then topping. This will increase the best taste.   Price is good. But more protein did not mean you get more food. I would suggest that more protein with more food.

Flames Indian Restaurant is one of the up coming Indian cuisine at south Tampa. The cuisine does tone down a bit for the local American. It is still maintained a good spice mixture that represents the Indian cuisine. The decorations of the restaurant is nice. While we eating there, there are some local come to pickup the take out.   We have the Phatthar Gosht Ka Saalan. It is a lamb dish from Hyderabadi Cuisine. This dish to me the spice is enough. However I think missing the heat of the spiciness. It has s still delicious.   I like the most is the Chicken Chettinad. It is a classic chettinad dish with great flavor. I like the sophisticated of the spice. It is great dish to go with rice.   Both dishes is good. Portion is a bit small. Service at the restaurant is good. If you not use to the spicy Indian foods, this may be a good choice. They do have good taste.

It is about 4.5 stars. Onur is part market and part restaurant. This is a Turkish market for item like Turkish delight and all the Turkish goods such as tunas jam, coffee, spices, flour, marinated steak and more.   We got some of the cookies and milk drinks mixed and a kabab to go. We have the chicken kabab and it comes with veggies. You will not believe the kabab is good. Love the juicy chicken kabab.   The menu of the restaurant was easy to select. The price is affordable in compare to full middle eastern restaurants. The kabab was prepared in ten minutes. In compare to restaurants I usually waited for half hours. This is the plus to prepare the food quick and quality.

This Bento has great setup among many Bento I have been to. Set up is very nice with indoor or outdoor dining. The elevated outdoor concrete floor serve a very good view and away from the vehicles.   I have sushi box with yellowtail caliente roll and salmon roll. It come with California roll, goyoza, salad and spicy cucumber pickles. This bento box is fresh and good. The food do improve a lot from old day. My wife have bento box of chicken katsu. The chicken was two flat pieces. It also accompanied with noodle and brown rice. The salad and wonton skin also includes in the box.   There is not much of service. It is order at the counter and bring a number to your table. Food was delivered by your number.

Very close to 4.5 stars. This restaurant has potential. Newly open. It give good quantity of food. It is upscale fast food with good flavor. Menu is easy understanding. A three step process to select what you want.   First step is to choose the your entree. This includes burritos, quesadilla, bowl, taco. Next step is to choose your protein, it includes different types of chicken, pork, steak or ground beef, shrimp. Base on type of protein will determine the price of the items. Next step to choose your add on. They have good choices. I got the steak quesadilla. The add on was delicious. It take 10 minutes to prepare my thick quesadilla. It has good cheese. My wife have BBQ pork. The bowl is huge with add on. She like the taste of it.   Overall I said it is good value for the food we have. I like the good thick quesadilla. Enough steak in it. Good grilled steak.

This is our second stop happy hour restaurant. Malio is restaurant near Curtis Hixon park. If you happen to be there, you may want to check on their happy hour from 3 to 7 pm Tuesday to Friday. Their happy hour food item is great.   I start with their high west old fashioned. It is a double Rye whiskey. It has some kick into it. Good deal at happy hour. Our selection for the appetizers begins with filet tips it was grilled very well. Good to share with friend. Our next appetizer is Ahi Tuna Tartare. It serve with wonton chip and pickles ginger. Tuna was good. Our last appetizer is the Shrimp Theresa. It is grilled shrimp with ponzu crispy outside. I like this appetizer the best. It come as six pieces.   Overall we enjoy our time here. Service is good. Parking at the building is $6 if you want to park close. They do have coupons but still need to pay $6 for parking. I think it defeated the coupon.

My friend have a surgery here which give me an opportunity to visit this hospital. I was not aware of this hospital is located in the middle of south Tampa. It is convenient for the south Tampa residents to visit their love one if they need a surgery. I would suggest any short duration of surgery should be close to home. It allow immediate family care without traveling abroad.   This hospital is rather nice because there was plenty of parking space for visitors. Their park is just a walking distance. The hospital keep clean and comfortable for the patients. The recovery room for overnight stay is good. The only thing is need a bit of visitors chair. I am guessing most recovery room due to short duration stay, the room is designed for patients and family. They don't want a party in the hospital due to many visitors.

I stopped in here for lunch on a Tuesday (4-12-16).  Although it is part of a strip mall with plenty of parking, the interior is anything but typical.  A wall sized mural and elegant tables await the diners.  I was a little disappointed that some items are available in the dinner hours, so I ended up choosing a couple other items and relying upon getting a to go box for what I didn't finish.  My first item was the Grilled Shrimp with Wild Mushroom Risotto, braised tomato, ratatouille vegetables, Broccoli and Crispy Onion.  This was a nice sized portion for lunch and the flavors were well suited for accompanying the shrimp.  I would definitely recommend this.  I also ordered the Chicken Almond Croissant with roasted rosemary chicken, toasted almonds, celery, onion, tomato, bacon aioli, petite greens and barbecue chips.  Again, this was a delicious combination.  (I saved half the sandwich so that I would have something to eat later in the evening.)    I plan on returning with my wife and friends soon to be able to sample some of the evening menu.  Review #31

Timing might be the biggest cause for my mediocre rating of this nature preserve.  I expected there not to be many flowers in February, but the recent rains really curtailed my enjoyment of exploring the trails.  So, I only visited the prairie side of the park.  There are lots of bird houses on poles throughout the prairie side.  There is a covered kiosk area near the pull-off (not really a parking lot as just a patch of gravel by the roadside.)  The kiosk had plenty of room to display information , but what was there looked aged and didn't really catch my attention.  So, I hope to get back this spring, after a dry spell, to check out the flowers and greenery as well as the back woods beyond the prairie while taking a long hike.  Review #610

Wolf Run has the potential to be a really great park on the south east side.  It is easy to find just off Thompson Road and has a paved parking lot near the shelter and playground.  There is a paved walking path oval around the park and basketball courts on the west end, away from the playground.  There is no parking/street access for the courts without hiking or biking, but it offers a distance which keeps older kids from the younger ones.    The playground has two sets of equipment:  one for bigger kids and smaller equipment for the tykes who might not be as safe on some of the bigger pieces.  They are conveniently spaced for parents who need to watch both.    There is a large lawn area for playing athletic games, but very few trees for shade.  Maybe future plantings can be arranged to offer a break when the hot days of summer approach.  Review #676

If you love disc golf, you may love this park.  The full 18-hole course is nearly a mile in length.  It has holes that are in the woods as well as ones on the open green space.  If you aren't a disc golf fan, there isn't much else for you here other than walking the course and a few narrow trails along the river.  There are a few picnic tables and grills, but no shelters or restrooms.  And if you're concerned about your car hitting potholes as you drive in, you may want to look elsewhere to visit.  The gravel road was in bad condition and made it challenging to get back to the paved parking lot...which has its own roundabout!  Review #738

I stopped by to see what this location had since I had enjoyed my stop at the Keystone at the Crossing location.  This place is noticeably larger with more room to move around.  The inventory seemed to be different here.  More focus on home decor (serving dishes, rugs, etc) and less of the cute stuff that I liked at KatC.  The price is upscale which is expected on this side of Indy, so I wasn't too shocked at anything.    They do have some whimsical items like the stuffed penguins & flamingos, but not much variety.   The man behind the desk greeted me when I came in but wasn't intrusive as I browsed, staying at the counter while I was there.    I didn't find anything to buy on this visit, but some things did catch my eye and made me pause to consider them.  Review #2022

I stopped by late in the lunch hour after roaming around in the January chill.  I wanted a simple cup of coffee and noticed an eye catching array of large muffins sitting on the counter.  So, a cup of House Blend coffee and a giant crumble topped apple (caramel?) muffin for under $4.  Very cool.  The shop was being manned by the owner and he was very pleasant and helpful.  We chatted a while since the morning rush had passed.  I headed upstairs and was glad to find the coffee was served at the right temperature to drink right away.  No scalding!  The house blend was a bit stronger than I usually like, but the flavor was deep and rich and I quickly adjusted.  Oh, and that muffin was phenomenal!  Light and cakey inside, but with chunks of seasoned apple inside.  And the top was crumble topped with a slight crunch and drizzled with a hint of frosting.  One of the best muffins I've had!  I'm not sure if they make them or buy them from someplace else, but I will find out the next time I return.    Review #2094

This new shop in Mooresville looks like it's off to great start with a beautiful collection of house plants and artisanal pots/accessories.  For a small shop, I was impressed with the variety they offered.    In addition to the house plants, the office part of the shop carries Indie Coffee Roasters coffee (Carmel) and a selection of oils, including CBD oil.  They have a few parking spaces out front and some additional spots behind the building.  Unfortunately, the current business hours are limited to a lunch time window three days a week and only extend into early evening hours on Thursdays.  Hopefully, they will be successful enough to expand the store AND the hours if they want to compete with all the big box discount plants in the area.  Review #2109

I enjoyed browsing through Papyrus inside the Nordstrom wing (east hall) of Keystone at the Crossing.  They had a really nice window display with painted wooden holiday items that caught my eye.  Inside, they had a number of greeting and holiday cards, some games and books, and accessories for wrapping. There were even some small gift items too.  The shop was full, but not too crowded on a weekday.  Seems like a great place to grab some last minute cards/wrapping paper if you did some shopping in the mall without having to stop someplace else.  Good location!  Review #1963

This place was by far the busiest of the three gift shops on Mass Ave that my wife and I explored.  With a name like Silver in the City, she expected it to be more of a jewelry store.  When she passed by that section of the store, no one asked if they could help.  There was a lot of stuff, a wide variety actually, but the place felt cramped and crowded with a line stretching back from the pay counter like you would see at a department store with kids waiting to see Santa.  Either not enough help or enough registers...not sure, but I found the experience difficult to maneuver and actually look at the goods.  Maybe I will have better luck on a weekday when the crowds aren't so large.  Review #1834

This is one of the better parks on the near southwest side.  There is a really great playground and splash area for the kids.  There is a paved pathway for walking around the prairie area and a basketball court for older kids.  They have a shelter and picnic tables close to the playground too.  Though everything looks to be in pretty good shape, the park doesn't have much parking of its own.  There are a handful of spaces on the south side of the park, but I imagine some folks park at the nearby elementary school and walk over.  The park could also use some tree plantings for shade and some benches around the playground/splash areas so that parents don't have to stand the entire time the kids are playing (especially if the shelter is rented by someone else).  It is bright and colorful and looks like a place kids could really have a fun time with equipment that isn't just the same old, same old.  Review #667

After having such a pleasant experience at the Mass Avenue store where we made some purchases, my wife and I made a point of exploring the Nora shop to see what else we might find.  Sadly, this store doesn't have nearly the diversity of items that the other store has.  And though there were three staff working (two were behind the counter without customers) and one was doing inventory), it wasn't until we were getting ready to leave that the one doing inventory greeted us.  So unlike the store on Mass Avenue where they asked if we had shopped their before and took the time to explain the fair wage system that they use, we could have come in and never known anything about the items on display.  I will stick to the Mass Ave store.  Review #2051

This park is nicely maintained and has a shelter and playgrounds with some open spaces for active sports.  It is on a hiking/biking trail so it makes for a decent rest area.  But it is a cookie cutter park lacking restrooms and running water that visitors (both park and trail types) could benefit from.  The mature trees are at the perimeter and so shade is limited to the shelter or sitting in your car.  Not much for older kids to do unless they have enough for a team activity.  Review #768

On our way home, my wife asked if I would stop at this local alterations shop to pick up a garment she had adjusted.  I will be the first to admit that I don't personally know much about sewing and alterations, but my wife does and she couldn't say enough about how reasonably priced this place is.  The woman who does the alterations is very friendly and my wife has been very pleased with the results.  Understand that you can't usually drop off some intricate garment and expect her to drop whatever she is doing to fix it.  But my wife was in no hurry and the garment was ready in a couple weeks.  There are a couple changing/dressing rooms for visitors to try on their garments for marking and reviewing.  Note that the owner only accepts cash or checks, NO Credit Cards.  My wife found the place through the local grapevine, so when I saw it was already reviewed on Yelp, I was pleased to see the reviews echoed my wife's opinions.  If you are in the area, stop by this small shop just south of the Casey's at the intersection of Bridge St and Indianapolis Rd.  Review #3653

I stopped in Wednesday morning for a quick cup of coffee and a scone.  After a short wait in line, they took my order.  On the coffee, they asked if they needed to leave room for cream or if they could top it off.  On the scone, they offered to heat it (microwave).  It definitely added to the flavor to warm it up without making the scone chewy.    Be aware the coffee is extremely hot and will take awhile to cool down.    I was able to meet a friend and we were able to sit and chat without any pressure to move on as it seems to be a popular place for folks to log on and work while they sip their coffee.    Overall, it was a good experience and the prices seemed reasonable for a bistro.  Review #156

Location, location, location!  That's what makes this park hold its value.  It has a hill in the center of the park that offers one of the best views of downtown available from the east side, i.e.  for watching the sunset or fireworks.   Other than that, the park does have some nice paths to walk, plenty of large trees for shade, a playground with swings, and a shelter with a grill.  Unfortunately, it doesn't have a dedicated parking lot (street parking is free if you can find it.)  It also has no restroom facilities or running water fountains, so plan accordingly.    The park seemed fairly well maintained, but I hear it gets crowded during celebrations.  Review #512

My wife and I are big fans of Holcomb Gardens; so much so that we were married by the gardens back in '83.  Over the years, the park has maintained its basic appeal with long rows of gardens & hedges, art sculptures,  a pond/fountain, and benches with words of wisdom from philosophers and writers.  There is a roundabout with parking along the edges once you've descended the hill past the pond and observatory.  A small waterfall and springs is on the right as you near the parking.  The gardens have a gazebo and a permanent shelter that can be rented in case of inclement weather.  (We had our reception there.)  The park is also located along the canal, so if you want photo ops or are looking for a start finish spot, this might be the place for your adventure.  Review #1174

Although I don't stop for ice cream often, I will say that this chain has some of the better options available.  This shop was clean, had plenty of free parking in the shared lot, and it looked like the ice cream tubs/barrels on display were maintained and full.  (I hate looking through a long list of options only to find out the place is out of my first choice!)    The ice cream is fairly rich tasting and the flavors seem true to the description.  Not the cheapest place around, but that's okay as long as the quality is good and the wait isn't too long.  Prompt service and we were on our way!  Review #2626

This was my first visit to this shop on the east end of the fashion mall.  I didn't realize it was a part of the Pottery Barn/Williams-Sonoma business group.  The space was very open and easy to move around without feeling cramped.  Yet, despite the high ceilings and open space, it still felt cozy due to all the soft touches that were in each room.  Generally speaking, each section of the store featured an area of the home and items to consider adding to your own.  There was a section for bedding, one for dining/kitchen, and several for family areas or something to accessorize your bedroom.  Lots of cloth items and some plants (mostly small cactus in pots), and some knick knacks.  Although there were visible employees working the counter or stocking, I was not greeted or offered assistance by anyone while I browsed through the store.  That didn't stop me from looking around, but would have been more likely to encourage a purchase.  They do have some nice looking items that if I was looking to replace something in my home, would definitely consider coming back for.  Review #3301

This is an interesting shop to check out while visiting Irvington.  I was surprised to see it open late on a Sunday afternoon (their website says they aren't usually open on Sundays) and decided to stop in.  I'm not a religious person and don't believe in spells and potions and that sort of thing, but I do have respect for other individual's beliefs.  So wandering into here was something new to me.  They have lots of books and hundreds of herbs, they have incense and candles, lots of plants in the front window (not sure if those are for sale), and a room in the back for reading and classes.  They have bumper stickers with spiritual comments, sometimes humorous.  Basically, there are a lot of items to browse through that aren't like what you find in other places.  Apparently there are 50 artisans who provide their wares to the shop.  Review #1990

This auto car wash is the closest to my routine journeys, so even though I thought it was supposed to rain, I needed to get my car clean from the road salts that had accumulated and were making it difficult to see my mirrors clearly.    Frankly, I've had some hit and miss dealings here.  They have a fair priced selection of cleanings to offer through their standard pull up/place gear in neutral/hands of the wheel until finished operation.    What makes the difference is how much prewash scrubbing the attendants do before going through.  On this occasion, the guy did a really good job and my car came out looking clean and shiny.    However, on some visits, the attendants didn't do much, particularly along the rear license plate area and I've come out with grime still there because of the shape of my car and the inability of the scrubbing machines to reach there.    So, if you are in a hurry, the place can get your car generally clean, but you may need to do a bit of touch up at one of the stations alongside the building to finish.  Review #1976

I've been buying Soma products as gifts for my wife for quite a few years.  They make high quality clothing and I appreciate that their sleepwear has a wicking capacity that allows her to get a good nights sleep without feeling too hot or clammy.  Just a comfortable night's sleep.  So now that she has accomplished a significant weight loss, it was time to get something new.  I've always purchased items online before, but since we were at KatC, the location of the store seemed to be kismet.  She was free to browse around the store and check out the different styles, but like most places, not everything is in the right size.  Fortunately, she didn't give up and she happened to check out the clearance items and found just what she wanted on SALE!  The staff was friendly and wasn't pushy.  My wife was able to get her items quickly and they looked great on her as well as made her feel comfortable wearing them.  As long as they keep making quality products, we will keep purchasing these products.  Review #2463

Truth time:  I didn't make a purchase, so I can't say how the service is.  What I can say is that for being a Movie and Music store, I was surprised how much of the store is devoted to other kinds of merchandise, like t-shirts.  I remember going to the mall and buying CD's and movies and having tons of options.  Maybe it's because so much streaming / downloading is going on that these types of stores need to carry items that aren't electronic.    But I can only base my review upon what I know has gone before and though they have a nice selection, I wasn't impressed.  It's Okay, not anything unique or enticing.  Review #1907

Really high quality items in a small space with friendly folks there to assist you.  My wife and I enjoyed browsing around the shop on a Saturday afternoon and met one of the owners.  The shop was filled with unique items of furniture, accessories, candles, and other scent related items to create a sense of home.  Though they didn't have the specific thing my wife was looking for, they suggested taking a photo of the room/materials and sending them to the shop so they could help find something that would coordinate with our stuff.  Nice!  Very pleasant experience and we look forward to stopping by when we are next in the area.  Note:  This is another new business that opened in 2018.  Review #2154

I give credit to a company that realizes the product line is changing, so it adapts to become useful in other ways to keep its customers returning.  As more readers grab books online, the need for giant bookstores might become a convenience rather than a primary source.    So this chain has added lots of departments that aren't too far of a stretch from reading to appeal to customers and continue to bring them in.  Besides thousands of books, there was an artists supplies area, a video area, a toys and games area, periodicals, young readers, and a cafe!  Throw in convenient parking (free) out front and you could spend a lot of free time browsing the store, finding something of interest, and then grabbing something in the cafe so you don't have to wait to start reading!  Well kept and plenty of staff even on a Monday evening to assist customers find what they wanted.    Review #2160

after finding convenient parking in the shared lot in front of the restaurant.  We entered a spacious dining area with lots of tables, but only one server working the floor.  While pleasant, there were noticeable gaps in interaction. our order was taken and placed but it wasn't until we were seated that this restaurant did we realize it did not serve margaritas,  Mexican beer with sliced lime was as festive as it got. I ordered the street tacos which are served on small corn tortillas, I don't know if they offer flour which I prefer.      y wife ordered a burrito that had a side of rice packed inside.  It looked rather plain without any sour cream, cheese on top, or pico de galo.  Seemed like an incomplete meal compared to other local restaurants.  It wasn't a big deal to me but my wife commented that chips and salsa were not free.  $1 per order. There are numerous Mexican restaurants within a short driving distance, so in order for this place to make it.  I think it needs to raise its game on many levels.   Review #3976

I'm glad I gave this place another try.  This time, I ordered the lunch special "Squealers Favorite" which is the shredded pork topped with cole slaw and served with chips.  The pork was moist and had a nice smoky flavor.  The sandwich came with sliced onions, dill pickle chips, and a choice of barbecue flavors.  The cole slaw had a strong vinegar taste when sampled by itself, but when combined with the pork and all the sides, it gave the sandwich a full and well balanced flavor.  The sandwich is loaded with meat and slaw, so be aware that you may need all your napkins and the fork to get all of it.  Review #315

I discovered Graeter's Ice Cream on the menu at Mesh on Mass a few years ago and that's when the waiter told me that they were carrying it at Kroger's.  When I heard Graeter's was opening a shoppe in Broad Ripple, I had to make plans to stop in.    So glad I did.  The Black Raspberry Chocolate Chip is my favorite.  I only wish I lived closer so that I could try more flavors more often!  Review #35

Wow! What a great addition to the neighborhood!  This park used to be a lot smaller and frankly, the neighborhood was not that inviting.  But in the past few years, there has been a major reconstruction of 38th Street from the fairgrounds towards the Art Museum and this block in particular is looking much better.    There still is the small playground and shelter on the north end by the parking lot off Illinois.  There is a basketball court and lots of open ground for playing and running.  But the southern half of the park has the rec center and ultra cool playground with the spongy padded rolling hills that allow kids to climb, play music, jump, swing and go wild!  Oh, and there's a spray park between the parking lot and the rec center and some half court basketball courts to the east.  They even added some additional parking on 39th for convenience.  I would really love to see this area of town see a revitalization to the glory that once marked the near north side.  If this park is an example of the city's commitment to making a difference, then things will be well on their way!  Review #716

The park is a greenspace in the old downtown of Greenwood.  Located just north of the city library, it is a flat area alongside Pleasant Creek which runs along the north side of the park.  The main lawn of the park does have a pair of football goals but no lines to mark the boundaries.  On the east end, a pair of tennis courts also sit near Meridian Street.  There is a cluster of mature trees and a small play area in the southeast corner of the park.  For crossing the creek, a footbridge seems in good condition for traversing from Machledt Dr to the paved path leading to the courts.  The main function of the park appears to be for hosting city events due to its location and the availability of parking spaces at the library and at nearby businesses.  Review #665

The park has been a "go to" destination for Indy residents for generations.  What started out as a private residence, the park has undergone many additions and changes over the years.  In 2017, "The Ruins" had a major transformation:  the pool/fountain was removed and the splash area was added to the east side of the wall.  But unlike other splash parks, this one has "ruined" statues and animal sculptures that represent some of the wildlife in the park.  Beyond the ruins, there is a huge playground near the south entrance.  There are so many places for kids to swing, climb, and slide that they may wear out just running between them trying to use them all!  To the east, a nature center is on the north end while lots of nature trails lead off into the woods and towards the river.  Note that the trails have a fair amount of elevation change which may be challenging.  Overall, this 95 acre park has a lot to offer for those who want to enjoy nature and have kids that like to be active.  Review #732

Although there are plenty of flower and shrub places closer to us, my wife and I still find ourselves returning to Butler's just to make sure we don't miss something special.  Even though many places were picked over after Mother's Day, we still found plenty of quality hanging baskets and flowering shrubs at Butler's.  The friendly owners are on hand every time we go and answer questions about caring for the plants we buy.  Looks like we will continue coming back next year too!  Review #295

Although I don't get over to this side of town as often, I have to admit that when I think of buying something for my home, this place is one of the first places I think of.  Sometimes, it may be an outdoor decoration.  Maybe it's a holiday gift box (I hate using wrapping paper!)  The point is that they carry items that aren't like all the big box stores and this warehouse sized business has a huge variety to look over.  Sure, it's not fine art, but it is affordable and allows me to go with a style for a while and then, if I change my mind, not feel like I've wasted money when moving on.    They also have a large variety of glass and kitchen wares, floral arrangements (both assembled and components for when I feel artsy), and lots of holiday themed knickknacks.  Even when I don't make a purchase, I find it enjoyable to browse the variety of objects they carry.  Review #245

I stopped in and must admit, the food I had (carnitas burrito) was generously portioned and quite tasty.  I liked that it was made to order and the line moved quickly.  I really liked that they steamed the tortilla before making the burrito so that it was soft and warm and held its shape without breaking like I've had at other places.     They do have convenient parking and some tables inside for dining, but most of the folks were getting their food to go.  The line starts at the counter end by the door and you work your way down the line and the servers build your meal as you go.  (If you have been to Chipotle, then it is handled the same way.)  They do have some beer available, but I passed on these since I got my order to go.    Although there were some basics like burritos, quesadillas, and tacos, there was not as much variety as a number of Mexican based restaurants as I've dined.  So, if you want one of the basics, you can have it made to order here.  If not, then you may want to try someplace else.  Review #346

I stopped in with some friends while on the north side.  This outlet store sells caramels, chocolates and knick knacks for a family owned business based in Hagerstown, IN.  The founders (the Abbott's) started making caramels in 1890, and chocolates around 1910.  Although, the business was sold to others in 2012, the original recipes have been maintained for over 100 years.    And you can taste the quality in the products.  The caramels are melt in your mouth delicious!  The chocolates I purchased came in a variety of mostly bite sized samples.  Excellent options are available, some with milk chocolate, and others with dark.    Most of the candies are made in Indiana.  You can tell which are locally made by the title plates for each variety.  Other hard candies are available on site, but those, along with the knick knacks are produced elsewhere.    Besides the knick knacks, there are some gift packages available.  Some are strictly chocolates.  Others are chocolates formed into shapes to help celebrate different occasions.      Although the chocolates are on the pricey side, the quality is really good and worth checking out when you are looking for some instant gratification for your sweet tooth.  Review #355

If you like small chocolate bites, assorted truffles, and even barks and toffees, then you will not be disappointed by the variety and quality offered by Ganache.  I stopped in (street parking is free in the area) and decided to get a few items to go.  I like that most of the chocolate bites come in milk chocolate and dark chocolate options, and some even come with white chocolate too!  The truffles show artistic skill as well.  My only negative is the pricing.  Some chocolates were $38 per pound!  I've had delicious chocolates from "mom and pop" confectioners that were less than half that price that were equally tasty.  I picked up six pieces of candy for over $8.  Truffles run about $3 each.  If you have a sweet tooth, this place can take care of you.  Just be sure your eyes aren't bigger than your wallet.  Review #428

I stopped by for lunch Wednesday afternoon.  I hadn't been to this restaurant for a long time, so I was pleased to see the changes in this location compared to the old one across the street.  The new place has a lot more light and more outdoor seating which is nice for days like today.    For the lunch crowd, the primary choice is to select from one of four types of pizzas that are fired up continuously and sold by the slice.    I added a side salad with my choice of dressing on the side.  Very reasonable price.  Unfortunately, the sliced tomato was lacking color and flavor.  I selected one of the special slices.  My choice had bacon, sun-dried tomato, fresh basil, and onion on a cracker crisp crust. Nice flavor combo!    Overall, I thought the food pretty good and the idea for offering pizza by the slice improves your chance for a quick meal during your lunch hour.  Review #157

Stopped in again for dessert after dining in Broad Ripple.  I got a bowl of Black Cherry Chocolate Chip ice cream, while my wife got a waffle cone of Black Raspberry Chocolate Chip.  Both were fantastic!  Our friend wanted to get a gelato, but they were out at the time.  Although a bit disappointed, she really enjoyed a child sized Banana ice cream cone.  Great flavors all around.  Rev #2

This local bakery has a tasty array of donuts, rolls, fritters, and cupcakes.  They even have full size cakes available too!  The prices are great.  I got six rolls & fritters for about $6.  The service was friendly and quick.  If you have a sweet tooth in Mooresville, this place has hours that accommodate customers.  Review #444

I am not a "hands on" kind of maintenance guy...I usually make matter worse than better.  Having confessed that, there are some tasks that even I can do.  And when I need a tool or piece, I always go to our local Lowe's.  The folks that work there are helpful and aren't hard to find like in some other big box stores.      They usually have the items I need, but if they don't, they are willing to order them for me.  I don't spend a lot of time waiting in line either.  They have plenty of room in the aisles and they have a complementary lawn and garden center that has a nice variety of plants and veggies.    Review #255

While in Speedway, I decided to stop by this antique mall on Main.  Although it looks kind of small from the front, the mall becomes a split level shop about half way back.  The front half has a central room with smaller rooms off to the left and right.  I was pleased to see these were arranged nicely, in some cases, like someone's living room.  It made it very easy to move around and to view the items in the context of how they may look in my own home.  In the back half, the shop is more rows of booths than rooms.  Things are a little less formally arranged, but still good for browsing.    Due to the proximity of the track, there were quite a few booths featuring racing and car memorabilia, so if you are a fan of those, this is a definite place to stop by.  Review #1973

Although we don't need these types of supplies regularly, it's nice to have a place that offers a variety of items to meet our needs.  My wife needed some materials and we were able to find them within a few minutes.  Checkout was breezy too.  My only negative is more the condition of the store:  looked rather dirty and trashy by the entrance (particularly just inside) which made an immediate negative impression.  Come on folks, pick up the debris and push a broom.  Review #2293

Blooms by Dragonfly is a small business in the heart of Old Town Zionsville that is a florist shop as well as Home Decor and Gift items.  In addition to coolers with flower arrangements, my wife was quite impressed with the live plant offerings; so much so that she ended up making a purchase claiming the peace lilly was a fraction of the cost of some other large/chain florists she has shopped.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  We were able to get advice on how best to maintain the live plant as well.  The rest of the store has stuffed animals, inspirational messages on items, and general things to use as knick knacks or wall hangings.  Cute shop!  Note that upstairs is another business where you can get personalized signs made.  Since I didn't find anyone to talk to up there, I haven't set it up as a new business.  Review #2642

This is a decent pet shop with friendly workers, plenty of space in the aisles, and a nice selection of items.  There are larger pet stores around the metro area, but this one focuses on having pet supplies, not all the ancillary services that those may have.  In addition to the supplies, they did have a few live animals:  2 cats, a bunny, budgies/parakeets, and some small furry critters too.  (Note:  I did not see any part of the store set up for selling dogs, so those early negative reviews may have contributed to a change.)  If I lived in the area, I could see coming here regularly to pick up supplies.  Review #2142

Across from the pay parking on Westfield Blvd is a tiny shop that is literally on the alley.  During warmer months, they even bring some of their items out into the alley during store hours.  Inside the shop, you will find nice quality items like furniture, paintings, and some knick knacks.  During the winter months, the business is making the most of some available space at the corner of Westfield and Guilford.  In that annex, there are lamps, clothing, and more small items that might work in a collection or as a gift.  The only negative is that the supply is rather small compared with other antique shops.  I'm not sure how quickly the inventory turns over, so you'll just have stop by to see whether they have what you're looking for.  Review #2279

There are lots of great arrangements available, especially during the holiday season.  And as the clerk told me, the savings should get bigger as it gets closer to the big day!  When I first walked in, I was impressed with the beautiful display of color making me feel more festive just by walking through.  A number of the arrangements are made in house.  There were also Christmas trees from small to fairly life sized already decorated and ready to go.  Other items like ornaments, stuffed animals, and characters of assorted sizes were around.  The west side of the store was still dedicated to floral and bridal accessories, but I didn't spend much time on that side.  Hurry over if you want to pick something new to make your home more festive...and save some big bucks!  Review #1928

I have enjoyed smoothies from this locally owned smoothie franchise at their Carmel location and at a Yelp event, but this was my first visit to the new Fishers location.  Like the other, there is parking out front, an order counter, and tables to dine and/or wait for your order to be served.  The list of options (including calorie count) is overhead behind the counter.  After ordering, you pay and give them a name to identify the order.    I selected a Blueberry Bliss smoothie.  Note that they only have one size for their smoothies and they seem quite large to me.    I really enjoyed the fruit forward flavor.  Note that although they don't seem super cold, I did get a bit of brain freeze from drinking it too fast.  My only complaint is that there was some loud equipment running near the order counter, which when combined with the background music,  made hearing the staff's questions a bit difficult.  Review #3410

Our daughter had recently purchased a table and chair set from Urban Styles and had a positive experience here, so my wife wanted to check out the store since she liked the style.  Although we didn't make any purchases, we were amazed at the unique and stylish pieces we saw here.  Whether it was furniture or accessories, the items were different from anywhere else.  The prices do tend to run on the expensive side, but there were sales going on to bring the prices down to a more affordable range.   When we entered, we were greeted and asked if we were looking for anything in particular, and then given his name if we had any questions.  We then browsed around the different spaces set up like rooms or collections for a good half hour.  Everything was really cool.  The only negative was that when my wife had some questions about one of the sets, she went to the guy who had greeted us after he had gotten off the phone.  But instead of coming over, he made another phone call.  After awhile, we gave up and left.  Lost sale.  waugh waugh!  Review #2048

If you've been to any other Pier 1, then you will be familiar with the types of items you'll find here.  They have a candles section, an art/wall decor area towards the back, lots of stuff for you kitchen and dining room decor as well.  They also carry a limited amount of seating/furniture scattered throughout, but mainly the middle section of the store.  The checkout counter in this one is set right in the middle so if you have questions, you don't have to waste time searching for someone to answer.  They maintain a nice balance between seasonal and everyday time items as well.  Although we didn't make a purchase on this visit, the store carries a variety of quality items that would warrant a return visit when in the area.  Parking is shared with other shops in the Willow Lakes plaza.  It fills up fast on the weekends.  Review #3321

I stopped in to check out this combination Hallmark/Pandora/gift shop after having enjoyed the one in Vincennes.  Like that other shop, this had a wide variety of items including the cards and women's wear/items, toys, puzzles, and lots of small items that would make for pleasant gifts.    Like all Hallmarks, there were still some marked down Christmas items hoping for someone to pick them up.  The only difference between this store and the one in Vincennes version is that the other greeted me as soon as I entered and made me feel welcome.  Here, the woman was busy changing out inventory and didn't acknowledge any of the customers browsing in the shop.  Review #3632

When I look for a movie theater, I look: at what's showing; are the times convenient; and does it have prices that are reasonable.  Well, I was looking for showings of some independent films and found them at this Regal.  Located near Greenwood Park Mall, I found one playing on a Tuesday around lunch time, and on the following Sunday in the morning.  I was pleasantly surprised that I got great prices both times (under $7).  When I went, the lines were really small and the service was prompt.    The theaters have the "reserve" seating feature and the fully reclining seats available.  So, I was able to get great seats at both movies and could adjust my position easily during the films.    The theaters were clean and the restrooms were well lit and had been maintained.  Based upon my positive experiences, I have added this location into my "go to" options to see first run films.  Review #475

My wife and I have dined here several times, usually during the Devour North promotional event.  Each time we have received excellent service and delicious food.  During the most recent visit, we brought a friend for the first time.  We each ordered a different entree from the menu and everyone enjoyed their meal.  I ordered a house salad and was able to substitute blue cheese for the goat cheese that was listed on the menu.  When you know that something just doesn't suit your palate, it is really appreciated when you can make a change to something like a salad.  I then tried the Teryaki Salmon with shiitake sticky rice and soy butter sauce.  This was delicious.  The julienned mixed veggies on top added a nice crunch and taste.  I would definitely order this again.  Finally, I finished off with a refreshing raspberry sorbet.  Not only was it tasty, but it served as a nice palate cleanser to finish off the evening.  Note:  If the weather is nice, there is open air seating in the bar area that can be very pleasant.  Review #54

Although the store is clean and bright, I couldn't help but feel like something was missing from this store that I've experienced at the other Pier 1 stores in the area. This one has lots of furniture and accessories for decorating your home and the quality appeared to be there too.  However, there didn't seem to be as much of a candle selection as other shops.  There didn't seem to be as many international themed items as other stores (unless I just missed them.)  I am not sure of the status of this store as my wife tells me the parent company is having some financial difficulty.  Maybe the inventory was reduced, or maybe it's just the manager's priorities.  If I hadn't been in numerous other Pier 1 stores, I may not have noticed, but this store is fine for most home decor items.  Just didn't quite have the appeal of some of the other locations.  Review #3669

When I was younger, I saw the classic animated Disney feature "Fantasia" and was amazed at the synchronization between the images and the music.  Watching the dancing lights on the lawn of Oldfields (The Lilly House) at Newfields brought back all those wonderful memories.  The lawn, the trees, the shrubs, just about everything has lights that are synched and really are enjoyable.   Not only is the light show great, there is a snowflake bridge and a kissing arch (it's a little off the beaten path!). There are places to get warm beverages and s'mores, and a self-guided tour of the Lilly House which is bedecked with poinsettias and Christmas lights/villages inside.  Parking was easy and free during the week.  Tickets sell out in advance for weekends, so it's best to save money by buying online at the Newfield's website and not taking any chances.  There are two blocks of times:  5 pm and 7 pm.  Certain dates even have a costumed fella in a red suit show up!  Very nice addition to the IMA and Indy's winter celebrations.  Review #468

The restaurant, bar,brunch place is worth the effort it takes to get through all the downtown construction and parking challenges.  My wife and I wanted to get out and this newly opened spot. Had caught my eye.  Located on the site of the former Kruger's on Delaware next to Stouts Shoes with additional access from Mass Avenue.  The industrial interior has retained much of the noteworthy artwork of the former restaurant but has added a nice soft lounge area in addition to the tables and bar seating.  There is also additional outdoor seating on the patio along Delaware.  So if you avoid the busiest of times, you should be able to find some seating suitable for you.  I have read some reviews that thought it too loud,but our inside dining at lunch was tolerable for conversation.   While there we chose to order a dine in meal and we also ordered beverages.  My wife got a local craft beer while I opted for one of the house cocktails. Both very enjoyable.  If you like good food, food service, and good beverages, make some plans to check out Oakmont,  Review #3922

When I first thought of the concept, I was a bit skeptical that this was a viable restaurant.  But  then I started reading the reviews and decided to give it a try.  Sure you can make a good pbj at home, but this place has such variety of PB, some I had never heard of.  I decided to go unconventional and really enjoyed my sandwich.  My only regret was that they had run out of he jelly flavor that was my first choice.  I guess I will have to return.  Service was friendly and the wait was short.  The sandwiches ran about $7 so be aware the bill willgrow quickly.  Review #3978

The inventory of this place is amazing.  There are so many gaming and action figures that my head was spinning.  So many cool things for collectors of fantasy themed pieces that I have to admit it is the largest collection I've seen.  However, it looks kind of like a teenager's room when you walk in.  Boxes of stuff clutters the walkways and the place could use a good cleaning.  Maybe that appeals to the normal clientele, but I found it distracting.  I wasn't able to discern any sense of grouping for some areas of the store.     This place could be so much better with a bit more effort to making it organized and maintained.  They have a great collection...it just doesn't look like it.  Review #2082

My wife and I decided to get out for lunch to a  new franchise restaurant that opened Avon.  Not only do they carry a wide range of wines and flights to chose from.  They have delicious options for lunch and dinner.  The interior is spacious with table eating and bench seating.  Rev #3984.

At a local gathering of food trucks this morning, I split an order from Serendipity Mobile Catering with a friend.  She ordered the "NorthEast" which is two crab cake minis with roma tomato, red onion, romaine lettuce, and topped with a roasted red pepper aioli on toasted gonella buns.  The sandwich should have been called a "slider" because there was enough aioli to cause the ingredients to slide to the side while being carried to our seats.  All kidding aside, the flavors worked really well together.  The crab cake was moist, though I have had some elsewhere that the crab was more prominent in flavor.  Still, because the flavors balanced so well, I found the sandwich quite tasty!  Review #85

While waiting on the west side, I stopped in to pick up lunch, wanting to be sure I had enough in case my wife wasn't able to catch lunch that day (4-28-16).  I noticed a few seats available in case I wanted to eat while there, but decided to place an order of Broccoli Beef and fried rice to go.  I also asked for orange chicken and for an order of crab meat rangoon with sweet and sour sauce.  After a brief wait, my order was delivered.  From the counter, you can see each meal freshly prepared.  The portions were generous and the taste was pretty much as expected...an Americanized version of Chinese food.  Very agreeable flavors for traditional palates.  I didn't order anything that would let me discern a difference from this restaurant and one of the chain restaurants like Panda Express.  So, for me, I would say the two restaurants are interchangeable unless you have a desire for something more exotic.  (I did notice a much larger number of options available from Peking.)  Review #18

The Art & Nature Park is a nice place to go to go for a hike or spend a little time with nature.  The hiking loop is about 1.5 miles around and is fairly level.  The only challenge is whether the water level (the park is a retention pond for runoff from the interstate) floods out part of the trail.  The park is a bird sanctuary as well.  In the middle of the eastern most pond, there is an island that is off limits to park visitors, yet close enough to be seen from the shore.  There is art scattered around the trail, but none of the pieces has information about the name of the piece, the artist, or when it was added to the park.  It seems that if you want to be an art park, there should be some information provided.  The parking lot is on the east end of the park and seems to be plenty for the number of visitors.  Note:  Watch out for the speed bumps on Dequincy as you head north from 21st St.    Review #575

I enjoyed stopping by this local toy store.  Instead of the towering stacks of over marketed items that try to get kids to buy them through marketing, here is a store that is built with the focus at kid's level.  Kids are encouraged to explore and see what attracts their own interests.  Some items are unique.  Some may remind you of something you had as a child.  There are so many types of toys and games that you wonder how they fit in this shop.  Stop by if you have a kid that is inquisitive or if you want to find something that will encourage your kid's imagination.  A great store!  Review #1175

I have stopped in twice in the last three months because I have a knack for finding nails to run over.  In both cases, service was given in less time than than the initial estimate was projected (the business was very busy on both occassions.)    Even though I am still driving on the original (dealer) tires, my tires were filled and repaired for NO CHARGE!  Talk about paying it forward to the customers!  Earlier in the week, my wife needed new tires for her vehicle and she was very pleased with the quality of service and the wait time for the installation.  She has raved about how smooth her car now rides with the new tires.  I am very pleased to support this neighborhood business that provides quality materials and service to its customers.  Review #121

I stopped in for lunch and didn't even have time for all the fun stuff outside!  But I did have a chance to get something from the new menu and sample a few sips of house brew.  I was very pleased indeed.  I chose the bar for seating and found the bartender to be helpful in making selections.  I tried the hoo-hoo honey ale, a pilsner, and a peach ale, all of which were full of flavor.  I settled on the house pilsner.  For lunch, I opted for the grilled cheese with the sauteed green beans as my side.   The beans came in a light sauce that was delicious and lifted the taste of the beans to another level.
